source_doc:
In a surprise Inspector Clouseau twist, I now have an extra thing to investigate for Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I was doing a quick scroll through the evenings secondary camera video, when I spotted a curious The Inspector standing on the trunk of the tree near the feeding station. Kept jumping around, finding him near where the magpies had been, so I initially suspect(edit) he was simply chasing them as they sometimes let him do, until I randomly chance stop...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

There Inspector Clouseau was, rolling around like crazing about 2 meters NE of the tree, mostly hidden by the unfortunate placement of the awnings east post. Still, there he was for 5 minutes, at which point he ran back up the tree, walked across the lawn to the hill, flattened himself at the bottom, and then ran off camera, presumably in the middle of The Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Now, as some of my Spooky Kitties Sciences readers may know, the motivations behind that tests are not just to entertain the kitties. While the most important aspect is the genuine curiosity I had seeing the kitties rolling around in the snow, I really wanted to find something that The Inspector liked. I came out of the initial testing with only a single moment to hint that he liked something. What that was is still a mystery.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

source_doc:
:redpanda: sometimes people will ask us like "what if you got a publisher for [game] wouldn't that be wicked?" but the problem is that all that would have to go through our game director, Ashe, who's said she wont speak to any publisher who doesn't address her as Ashe
the second she gets "Jess" the deal ends

:redpanda: and in a world where like, not even the AI slop publishers sending AI emails, but the people who have been flat out rude and some of them like, you could *feel* the misogyny dripping off their email, we're not really interested in talking to any of them lol

:redpanda: (I will shout out the publishers who have reached out to us though who have been like "here's some of the games we've published" and, out of their catalog, they picked out exclusively furry games. at least they did their homework)

:redpanda: anyways if you ever were like "I don't understand why Blobun isn't on switch? it'd be a perfect fit" that's why, and we can't afford the devkit and version of gamemaker that does that export, so yea you gotta go steam deck (or x86-ARM converter on those anbernics) if you want it on the go

at the end of the day, it's always going to be possible that some enemy picks up some combination of abilities/items where the combinatorial explosion of possibility space is unable to calculate fast on any hardware, so I was always going to need to cap it somewhere, just that theoretical cap is now 40x bigger than it was in january

Welp think I'm going to implement UCT because my game's just Go now this is going to be a journey

source_doc:
@kagan Just use anything, even the cashier receipts from your grocery shopping - whatever you want. A friend of mine who exhibits a lot put a sheet of toilet roll from every place he's exhibiting in his scrapbook another friend got injured while hanging her frames and eventually used the cast from the injury and some gouache to stamp patters on the pages. Hence: everything's involved you want involved.

@aurora And then you... take all these things, and glue, staple, or otherwise attach them into a book? Is that it?
I'm unclear on what happens next, or why.
Honestly, I may just not be a scrapbooking person.

@kagan Yes, that's exactly the way to go! Intentionally spill your coffee, drop an ink cartridge... whatever suits you. One just needs to get all these fancy ideas shown on pinterest or whatever out of one's head. It's about documenting the process instead of being a visual dainty. Use it like a wrecking journal if that suits. It's totally up to the person who makes it.

source_doc:
Good Morning Worlds!
We are going to the tip this morning. It will clear some of the stuff we sorted yesterday from the drive. I don't think we can clear it all unless we took the trailer, but the trailer is full of steel for weighing in.
Later I might carry on packing tote crates.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Tip trip done, and another car load cleared out.
I have taken the new trailer axle, and trailer drive motor system, out of the scrap metal trailer load. That means we can get more scrap metal in there and also not accidentally weigh in the parts I want to keep.
I think, next, I will start moving the scrap steel from the back garden into the trailer so that it is ready to go.
Scrap steel prices are not very high at the moment but better than nothing, if I take enough of it in one go.
Still have to sort the non-ferrous scrap.

That thing when you are taking the rotten tyres off small, wide lawn tractor wheels....
Huge effort to unmount one side of the tyre, but it was really badly rusted tight on the other side of the rim.
In the time it took me to break the bead free, I'd forgotten I had already done the other side, and ended up with the rim free but completely inside the tyre!
I had to remount the tyre that side, and then work around it to get the rim out.
I had to cut up the inner tube to get that out too!
I wonder how many more tyres I need to unmount? Four done so far.

Bun dé a düt le monn!
Incé doman jorone a la desciaria. Chësc desparagnará n valgünes cosses che trancé un metü d'anchëi söl stradun. Al m'inchietes nia chi s'co döt da n vaje sce nia chi s'portun la rorofes, mo la rorofes é plëna de fer por la desciaria d'or.
Plü tert podessi jé inant a cherié les casses.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Viazo ala desciaria fat, y n ater auto plën de patofles sciuré demez.
I á tut le nio asse de rorofes y motor de traziun de rorofes dales patofles de fer da sciuré demez. Chëst vö die che podun metü deplü fer da sciuré demez te l'auto y nia sciuré dles perts che i dles m'interessëia.
I m'pensi che, do, m'metarai a müté le fer da sciuré demez dal jort do cèsa te rorofes por ester pronti.
I prisc dl fer da sciuré demez nia n'é tgi bogn in chest moment, mo miú co nia, sce m'porté assá d'un n iade.
I á dancor d'ordonné le fer nia-ferus.

Chëla cossa canche t'es d'sciuré i gome marces dai pici, gragn dles gome di pici tratorns de jort....
Gragn sforz por desmuté un n lat de gome, mo al oara veramenter de rüscia söl ater lat de rim.
Nel temp che al á d'moré por l'desgancié, m'ái d'mentié che i l'ái bele fat söl ater lat, y al é sciurà che rim m'é gnü demez, mo döt dinfora dles gome!
I á d'vü d'muté dancor les gome söl chël lat, y do m'lauré d'atorn por fá gní demez rim.
I á d'vü taié la gome d'andré por la fá gní dancor demez!
M'dumandé cotantes dles gome ái dancor d'desmuté? Catr de fati cina sën.

I á tut l'asse nio de rorofes, y le motor de traziun de rorofes, dales patofles de fer da sciuré demez. Chëst vö die che podun mët deplü fer da sciuré demez lloché y nia sciuré dles perts che i m'interessëia d'avëi.
I m'pensi che, do, m'metarai a müté le fer da sciuré demez dal jort do cèsa te rorofes por ester pronti.
I prisc dl fer da sciuré demez nia n'é tröp bogn in chest moment, mo miú co nia, sce m'porté assá d'un n iade.
I á dancor d'ordonné le fer nia-ferus.

Chëla cossa canche t'es d'sciuré i gome marces dai pici, gragn dles gome di pici tratorns de jort....
Gragn sforz por desmuté un n lat de gome, mo al oara veramenter de rüscia söl ater lat de rim.
Nel temp che al á d'moré por l'desgancié, m'ái d'mentié che i l'ái bele fat söl ater lat, y al é sciurà che rim m'é gnü demez, mo döt dinfora dles gome!
I á d'vü d'muté dancor les gome söl chël lat, y do m'lauré d'atorn por fá gní demez rim.
I á d'vü taié la gome d'andré por la fá gní dancor demez too!
M'dumandé cotantes dles gome ái dancor d'desmuté? Catr de fati cina sën.

Ai tut fora l'asse nuef dla remorca y l sistem motor de traziun dla remorca dal ciarié de rottam de metal. Chësc vel dí che podun mëte ite ciamó plü rottam de metal y ence nia pesé por sbad i toc che voi tegní.
Crëi che sëgn scomenciaré a sposté l'azel de rottam dal jardin da do ite te la remorca, por che al sie pront da jí.
I prëisc dl azel de rottam n'é nia massa alti ai momënc, mo al é amëi che nia, sce nde porté assëz te na ota.
I messa ciamó separé l rottam nia ferus.

Chëla roba canche te es a tó fora i gomes marsc dai cërci pitsci y larc di traturs de prà....
N sfors enorme por smonté na banda dl gome, mo da l'atra banda dl cërch al jëra propi dut ciapà cun la rüscia.
Te l tëmp che m'à tut por staché l gome dal cërch, m'ëi desmentié che l'atra banda l'ëi bele fata, y ala fin ai ciafé l cërch liber mo dal dut dedant te l gome!
Ai messü remonté l gome da chëla banda, y do lauré d'intourn por trá fora l cërch.
Ai messü ence tajé sö la ciamera d'aria por la trá fora!
Me damani tanć autri gomes che mësc ciamó smonté? Cater ai bele fac fin ades.

source_doc:
Local stable out to cash in at Coffs with four contenders

Local trainer Noel Mayfield-Smith is hoping to have a lucrative day at Sunday's Coffs Harbour meeting with four runners stepping out for the stable on the six-race card.

The Group 1-winning horseman will start his day in the second event of the day when Ausbred Yahoo contests the Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605m) with two-kilogram claiming apprentice Ella Drew taking the ride.

Racing returns to Coffs Harbour on Sunday.

Ausbred Yahoo has been racing in good form with a third placing at Kempsey three starts ago being followed by two successive seconds at Coffs Harbour, the latest when beaten by Sunday's rival Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith links with another apprentice, three-kilogram claimer Leanne Boyd, when Never Island starts in the Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

A winner of three of her 15 starts, Never Island will carry 59.5 kilograms after Boyd's allowance. Never Island was beaten less than a length when second behind Montgomery at Grafton and backed that up with a last-start fifth at Coffs Harbour behind In The Fine Print when again beaten less than a length.

Raymond Spokes takes the ride on the Mayfield-Smith-prepared Monte Cruise in the O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205m).

Monte Cruise is also a three-time winner from just the nine starts. She hasn't raced since July when finishing last of eight at Eagle Farm and has had two trials at this track in preparation for her return, finishing second behind Saturday's Wyong winner Petticoat before winning the latest of them.

Mayfield-Smith rounds out the day when he again links with Boyd when she rides Cardsharp in the Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

L’atlet dl post Noel Mayfield-Smith spera de ciafé na jorndada davagnosa te l’incont de domënia a Coffs Harbour, cun cater ciavai dla stala che piia ia sön la carta de ot races.

L’alenadú, che á bele davagné na gara dl Group 1, pizará la jorndada tl secundo evënt dl dé cun Ausbred Yahoo che piia ia tl Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605 m), cun l’apevisant Ella Drew de dui chili che sará söl ciaval.

Le sport di ciavai mët dër man a Coffs Harbour de domënia.

Ausbred Yahoo á cors dër bun ultimamënter, cun n terzo post a Kempsey trëi gares ciavalades de n pe, spo dui secundi posć de riga a Coffs Harbour, l’ultimo canche al é stat batü dal rival de domënia Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith se colia cun n’andra apevisanta, Leanne Boyd de trëi chili, canche Never Island piia ia tl Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305 m).

Vincitria de trëi de sües 15 gares, Never Island jorojará cun n pëis de 59,5 chili do la detraziun de Boyd. Never Island é stada batüda por de manco de na lunghezade canche ara é arivada secunda do Montgomery a Grafton, y á confermé la buna prestaziun cun n chinto post te süa ultima gara a Coffs Harbour do In The Fine Print, canche ara é indô stada batüda por de manco de na lungheza.

Raymond Spokes mët man söl ciaval Monte Cruise, alené da Mayfield-Smith, tl O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205 m).

Ince Monte Cruise á davagné por trëi iadi sön ma nü gares. Mayfield-Smith complëta la jorndada canche al se colia indô cun Boyd, che jorojará söl ciaval Cardsharp tl Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305 m).

@la Isn't rule #1 of machining that if you haven't faced it off, it's not square or flat?

@azonenberg yes, of course, but I *did* mean to face it off. I just had my tool zero set wrong.
Because I assumed that it was roughtly flat.
I'm making an extra part today. I have the stock. And if I don't it will bug me to no end. Plus, during test fitting the bearing I broke the glue holding the part on my plate, so I would have to indicate it back in anyways, which I don't wanna dooooo, so.....

@la I know the feeling.
Had a similar problem when working on my house where literally every datum you might think of using was wrong.
I had a contractor frame a door frame plumb and square. Had to rip out a couple of studs after he left because the door needed to be like a degree off level in order to be flush with the floor and not floating in the air on one side.
Another (partial height) wall has each stud carefully cut to length because no two are the same size... The floor isn't flat so to make the countertop level you need the wall to be a parallelogram rather than a rectangle

source_doc:
Tonight in #MMRPG! My back finally shuts up enough that I can GM again as the heroes continue their search for the missing girl Cammie. Vega the Digital Dragon surprises a trio of mischievous scamps who snuck into her arcade in the middle of the night but one of them recognizes her as a town superhero and they end up having a heartwarming moment geeking out over video games. Unfortunately, the moment is interrupted by somebody or something landing on the roof of the arcade... 1/?

Vega goes to investigate and finds Dr. Vesper, in his monstrous bat form that the press has dubbed the "Gargoyle Man," along with a harpy-like creature that Vesper describes as his "little protegee." Vesper says that they have come to introduce themselves and invite Vega to join their society of man-creature misfits that is led by "The Madame," Dr. Diana Laughton of the Laughton Institute. 2/?

Vega buys some time to get the mischievous scamps out of the arcade and call the rest of the Mythics for backup, then plays along at being interested in joining this "new family." Vesper and Harpy (who does not speak once during the interaction) lead Vega to a ship in the harbor, where the Laughton Institute appears to be packing up their things... presumably because they know they're drawing attention from Agent Carter and A.R.G.E.N.T. among others. 3/?
model_a_hypos:
Iasera te #MMRPG! Mia schina me lassa finalmënter assá en dëche por podëi fá dacassö da master, ince sce i heros va inant cun la chirida de Cammie, la porpola sparia. Vega, le Dragon Digital, aposta n trio de mofons de strisura che s’â infiltré te süa sala jocs de nöt manco mët, ma un de chi la reconësc sciöche na superheroina dl post y ai fësc a la fin n burt bel de bocia cuntan de video jocs. Malan che l’ocajiun vën rumpida da valgügn o valch che toma sön l’at de la sala... 1/?

Vega va a ciaré y ciata le Dr. Vesper, te süa forma de batarela mostrosa che la stampa á batié "Gargoyle Man," adöm cun na creatura che semea na arpia y che Vesper descrî sciöche süa "pica sciöla." Vesper dij ch’ai vën a se presenté y a envié Vega a se sodescé a süa sozieté de creatura-man mostros che vën menada da "La Madame," la Dra. Diana Laughton dl Laughton Institute. 2/?

Vega de fesc a dagné n pü' de tëmp por fá sciampé i mofons fora de la sala jocs y cherdé i d’atri di Mythics por aiüt, pona fej d’ester enteresada a se sodescé a chësta "fameia nöia." Vesper y Harpy (che ne riona nia na ota te chësc momënt) mën Vega sön n bastim tl port, olache al semea che le Laughton Institute sides pormez a mët adöm sües cosses... de segur de d’ëi che ai sá che ai tira l’atenziun de l’Aënt Carter y d’A.R.G.E.N.T. y d’atri. 3/?

Vega se davagna n pô de tëmp per fá jí fora i monesc malizious dla sala di videojüch y ciamé i atri Mythics per n aiüt, spo la fej da ester enteressada da s'unì a chësta "familia nöia". Vesper y Harpy (che no dij nia gnanca na ota durant dut l'incont) mena Vega sun na nef tl port, olache l'Istitut Laughton para da ester da impaché sü si roba... probablimënter ajache ai sa che ai é da atrá massa atenziun da Agent Carter y A.R.G.E.N.T., anter d'atri. 3/?

source_doc:
My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.

source_doc:
Ironing the lightweight green corduroy for my first try at the Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern. I don't know how I feel about the recommendation to use interfacing but it probably does want something to stiffen and thicken it a bit.
#millinery

Sachi's newsboy cap pattern advises to cut the crown pieces diagonal to the weave ("on the bias") to allow more stretch around the circumference but that will make the corduroy rows run aslant, where I prefer them vertical.
We shall see. This is the test cookie to get a feel for the pattern. I like corduroy for texture but green wouldn't be my first choice, and this fabric is lightweight enough that I should add a layer, whether interfacing or what-have-you from the stash.

On a second look, my fabric isn't corduroy at all, it's just velvet, so I can cut at 45° to the fabric weave like Sachi suggests in the Newsboy Cap pattern and it won't look strange.
#millinery

Sona le cordoroi vërt lëde por m’prové por le pröm iade col patrun de Sachi's Studio por le bersté da colors. Al ne m'ispira nia tröp da adoré le tlesc, mo al adorará dër de valch por al rorí y al spessí n pü'.
#millinery

Le patrun de Sachi's Studio por le bersté da colors aconsiëia de taié i toc dla corona a sbiech respet al dlesso ("sön le bias") por avëi deplü elastizité sön la zirconferënza, mo chëst foss de colpa che les rigaies dl cordoroi jess a sbiech, de penda che i les prëferësc verticales.
Al se odará. Chësc é le test por s'un dé na fia col patrun. A mi me bria le cordoroi por la textura, mo le vërt ne foss nia m'prima sora, y chësc tlesc é tan lëde che i dëssi pormez büsté n strato, che al sides tlesc che taca o valch d'ater da mi fustí.

A n secund udada, mi tlesc ne n'é nia cordoroi, al é de valüre, insciö che i pöl taié a 45° respet al dlesso dl tlesc sciöche Sachi aconsiëia tl patrun dl bersté da colors, zënza che al sides d'arshura.
#millinery

#chapeliere

L model de newsboy cap de Sachi conseia de taié i toc de la corona en diagonal al tessü ("sön sbias") por lascé plu de elasticité ntorn le zircunferënza, ma chest farà che les righe dl vellù vae a sturt, olache i les preferësc verticales.
Vedun. Chësta é la prova por ciapé n'idea dl model. Me plaj l vellù por la testöra, ma l verd ne sarissa nia mi pröma chirida, y chest tessü é assé liejer che i messarà jonté n stradé de plu, che sie n rinforz o ciodi che i à te la scorta.

A n secont cialé, mi tessü n'é nia vellù a coste gnanca, al é demé velvet, spo i poi taié a 45° dal fil dl tessü coche Sachi conseia tl model Newsboy Cap y al ne pararà nia stran.

source_doc:
Tinkering with my stereo system this week has got me thinking about an oddity that I've never been able to get to the bottom of...let's see if the Mastodon hive mine can help.
The amp is a Philips FA454 and the CD Player is a Philips CD150.
According to the amp manual I can connect the units with a "8-pole DIN to 5-pole DIN + 2 x single-pole CINCH" cable."
I take this to mean an 8 pin din to a 5 pin + stereo RCA cable...which sounds cursed.
Never been able to find one. Can anyone make one?

The service manual for the amp is nice and clear (picture 2 in above toot), but I can't find anything as nice for the CD player. I've attached a picture (picture 4 in the above toot) from the service manual that I *think* is the relevant section.
Currently I have the CD player hooked up with just the RCA cables and it all works fine, but if I could find/make the correct Din to Din + RCA cable then I could use some additional functionality and free up the only RCA stereo inputs on my amp.

There's a repair café this weekend in the town where I live...if I'm still puzzling over it all by then I might take it all along there and see if they can help me hack together a cable.

A puzelé deperpo con mi implant stereo chësta edema m'al fat pënse a n fat curiof che n'unse mai arjont da capí... asvelt sce le "hive mind" de Mastodon m'asiste.
L'amplificadú é n Philips FA454 y le letur CD é n Philips CD150.
Aldonco le manual dl amplificadú possi collié i dusc prosc con n cavo "DIN a 8 poli a DIN a 5 poli + 2 x CINCH unipolars".
I capësci che chësc oles d'orëi dí n cavo da DIN a 8 pin a DIN a 5 pin + RCA stereo... ciodí sönna dër mofëia.
N'unse mai ciafé n valgolas de te'. El cocun che n á la jof de s'un fá un?

Le manual d'asistënza dl amplificadú é bel y dër tler (figura 2 tl toot sora), mo n'arjonse nia de ciafé valch de tan bun por le letur CD. I á taché lapró n retrat (figura 4 tl toot sora) dl manual d'asistënza che i *pënse* sibe la pert interessada.
Śën ái le letur CD colié ma con i cavi RCA y döt fonziunëia bun, mo sce i podess ciafé/fá le dërt cavo da Din a Din + RCA spo podessi adoré valch fonziun d'ampustaziun y deliberé i sors ingressi RCA stereo sön mi amplificadú.

source_doc:
Falkirk strengthen top six hopes with away win at St Mirren

Miller then made sure of the points just after the hour mark as he capitalised on some static St Mirren defending to race on to his own blocked shot before dinking the ball over George.

It was an afternoon to forget for St Mirren, who lost Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips and George to injury as they slipped to a third straight defeat.

Falkirk had the first opening in the 18th minute when Barney Stewart laid the ball off to Dylan Tait, whose curling effort from just outside the box took a slight deflection before cannoning off the top of the crossbar.

St Mirren finally threatened just after the half-hour mark when Mikael Mandron shot from a tight angle, forcing Falkirk goalkeeper Scott Bain into a smart stop with his feet.

Falkirk then raced down the other end and the lively Miller was released and allowed to shoot from a similar angle but George comfortably saved.

The match was finally coming to life and Dan Nlundulu was the next to fire at goal in the 36th minute after the Bairns had given up possession cheaply, but it was a routine stop at the near post by Bain.

Nlundulu then got in behind and slid the ball home, though the cheers from the home fans were short-lived as the assistant referee raised his flag for what appeared to be a clear offside.

The hosts had already lost Donnelly to injury midway through the first half and they suffered a further blow when Phillips, who appeared to hurt his shoulder in the opening period, came off at the interval.

The match was crying out for a moment of quality and it came 10 minutes into the second half through Yeats.

Tait's perfect through ball released Miller, and although George came racing out of his goal and timed his challenge well, the loose ball fell invitingly for Yeats, who curled a stunning first-time finish into the top corner of the unguarded St Mirren goal.

It got even better for the away side just after the hour mark as the Bairns doubled their lead.

Miller's initial shot from the edge of the box was blocked by Scott Tanser but, as the home defence hesitated, Miller reacted first to run on to the loose ball and lift a right-footed shot over the onrushing George.

St Mirren suffered yet another blow shortly after as the keeper was forced off to be replaced by Ryan Mullen.

The enforced changes and the quickfire goals seemed to rock the hosts and they never threatened a comeback, with their afternoon summed up in the 89th minute when Tanser completely mis-kicked his attempted volley from six yards out.

Miller à spo aseguré i trei ponc póch do l’ura de jöch, co al à sfruté na defëisa massa ferma de St Mirren per curi sön sun so tiro sbarré y pó al à alzé la bala sora George.

Al é stat n domisdé da desmentié per St Mirren, che à perdu Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips y George per ferides, mentre che ai é tomés te la terza desfatada de fila.

Falkirk à abü n pröm’ocajiun al 18. minut, canche Barney Stewart à passé la bala a Dylan Tait, chël che cun n tiro a giré da fora dl’aria à tocé liejermenter n defensur dan che la bala sbaté söra la traversa.

St Mirren à finalmënter porté pericul póch do la mesa ura, canche Mikael Mandron à tiré da n angol strënt, costringion l portier de Falkirk Scott Bain a n bel intervent cun i pé.

Falkirk à spo curi dan l’autra porta y l viv Miller é gnü lassé liber, conzedion tié da n angol sciche chël, ma George à paré zënza problemes.

La partida jìa finalmënter ciapann vita y Dan Nlundulu à stat l prossem a tié a porta al 36. minut, do che i Bairns à perdu la posesciun massa bel, ma Bain à fat na parèda de rutina al pröm pal.

Nlundulu à spo intré do la linia defensiva y à mandé la bala te rëi, ma la jöia di fans de ciasa é stada cörta, ajache l assistënt dl arbitro à alzé sia bandiera per chel che parëa ester n ofsaid net.

I padru de ciasa à bele perdu Donnelly per ferida a mez dl pröm tëmp y ai à ciapé n auter colp canche Phillips, che parëa essers fat mé ales spales tl pröm tëmp, é gnü sostituí te la pausa.

La partida aclamâ n moment de cualité y chest é rivé diesc menüc do l scomenc dl secont tëmp tras Yeats.

La paséda perfeta de Tait te la profunanza à liberé Miller, y ence sce George é salté fora da sia porta y à tempisé ben so intervent, la bala lëdia é jita a pennel per Yeats, che à metü a segno n splëndit tiro al pröm toc a giré te l’angol de sora dla porta de St Mirren restada zënza custodia.

Per la scuadra ospita la situaziun é deventada ciamó miöur póch do l’ura de jöch, canche i Bairns à doplié l vantaje.

Le St Mirren á albü n'oltra bota de dert do n picer de tëmp canche le vachier á albü da jé demez por gní sustituí da Ryan Mullen.

I cambiamënć obliá y i coi d'or d döt de colf á desmisoré la scuadra de ciafra, che n'á plü mostré d'ester prigolosa por na rimonta, cun so domisdé rezorí al 89ejim menüt canche Tanser á döt faddé so thir de volo da sies iardes de dlongia.

Falkirk à abü la pröma granda ocajiun al 18. minut, canche Barney Stewart à scariché la bala per Dylan Tait, che cun n tiro a giré da pôch fora dl’area à ciafé na lieve deviaciun dan che la bala sbaté söra la traversa.

Falkirk à spo curü de l’autra man y l dinamic Miller é gnü liberé y lassé tié da n angol sciche chël, ma George à paré zënza problems.

La partida jìa finalmënter ciafann vita y Dan Nlundulu é stat l prossem a tié a porta al 36. minut, do che i Bairns à perdu la posesciun massa saurí, ma Bain à fat na parèda de rutina al pröm pal.

Per la scuadra ospita la situaziun é deventada ciamó miöur póch do l’ura de jöch, canche i Bairns à doplié l vantaje.

L pröm tiro de Miller da la limita dl’area é stat sbarré da Scott Tanser, ma, canche la defëisa de ciasa à esitè, Miller à reagí pröm, à ciapé la bala lëdia y à alzé n tiro col pé dret sora George che gnìa fora a gran coruda.

Campanīle
A #poetry thread
i.
A Roman church belfry,
gold cross reaching for clouds:
bell tolls, sets brass note free,
sings out through misty shroud,
its high peal an appeal
to the faithful long gone.
No more piety’s zeal:
many sunsetted dawns.
Its stone tower keeps watch
through the mask of dusk-rain,
skies loosing their barrage
upon roof tiles again.
🧵👇🏼
#poem #poemaday #moody #neoclassical #church #night #photography

ii.
Who pulled on the bell cord?
Lone monk in his cloister
with none left in accord.
He, grain in church oyster —
yet no cell holds his bed,
no dust stirred by his shoes,
his name never was said,
no old books that he used.
The bell rope hangs, worn, frayed,
gnawed by church mice’s teeth.
It’s been long since it swayed,
pulled by hands underneath.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
The night wind whispers psalms
and breathes canticles’ chant
to swing the clapper of bronze,
I answer in descant —
but not with my own voice.
The wind swallows my call,
chimes its own holy noise
with the hands of its squall.
✋🏼🧵

Campanīle
Na riga de #poesia
i.
Un ciampanì de na dlijia romana,
crusc d'or ch'arescghia les nives:
la ciampana sona, l'otun s'un va de balona,
al cianta fora por na nola de brognea,
al sona alt y al cherdia
i fedei che n'é dlongia d'agn.
Degun zele de pieté d'auria:
tanc de moris de soredlé.
La tor de pera sciava la bocia
tres la mascara dla plöia de domisdé,
i cìes ch'aspecolta les bombes
dô dles tebeles de tet indoman.
🧵👇🏼
#poesia #poesiadeporé #melfor #neoclassich #dlijia #gnot #fotografia

ii.
Chidore à tira la corda dla ciampana?
Monch su in te so claustro
che degun n'à plü dlongia d'al.
El, grain in te l'ostra dla dlijia —
mo degöna cela ne s'à tignì so let,
degun porf tarliscia dles coce dles fusties soes,
so inome n'é mai gnü dit,
degun liber vedl ch'al à dori.
La corda dla ciampana storta, schertlada,
mangiada dai dinc di soris dla dlijia.
Al é dlongia d'agn ch'ara ne se debrana,
tirada sota dales mans.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
L'ai de gnot ciantegna de psalms
y d'al sancia canticles
por debrana la batarela de bronz,
al respognes in descant —
mo nia con la mia usc.
L'ai s'ingloba la mia uia,
ciantegna so sanch muregn d'organs
con les mans de so bocia de sbalm.
✋🏼🧵

Un thread de #poejia
i.
Un ciampanil de gescia romana,
na crous d’or che toca les nües:
la ciampana suna, lascia jí la nota de bronz,
cianëda fora tras la cortina de nìa,
so sun aut n apel
ai fedei da sëgn incà jí.
Nia plü de zel de pietà:
tröpes albes de sorëdl a tramont.
So tor de pera tign sot ödl
tras la mascrina de sëra e plöia,
i ciels che lascia jí la tempesta
sun les töes del tet endò n’ater iade.
🧵👇🏼
#poejia #poejiadeldi #atmosferich #neoclassich #gescia #net #fotografia

ii.
Chi à tiré la soga dla ciampana?
Un münich sulet tl so clauster
cence plü degügn en acord.
El, gran te l’ostrica dla gescia —
mo gnanca na cela tegn so liet,
gnun polver movü dai sö cialzá,
so inom ne fo mai dit,
gnun vedl liber ch’el dovrâ.
La soga dla ciampana pënn, consumeda, sfranjeda,
rujeda dai dënc di mîs dla gescia.
L’é da n gran toc che ara ne se mova plü,
tirada da mans da sot.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
Le vent de net susura salms
e spira le cianties di ciantich
por fa balé le batac de bronz,
iu respogn en descant —
mo nia cun la mia propria usc.
Le vent se ngola mi ciamada,
suna so rumur sant da su
cun les mans dla so burascada.
✋🏼🧵

source_doc:
Progress after a while off. I got the sewing machine out to do the bill and a crown seam. Half the crown sewn plus the bill, resting atop the paper form made from the pattern. I had to rip and re-sew the machine stitch because I pinned along instead of across the seam and went off track. I might re-do the bill if I want a little more depth.
#millinery

Eight crown panels and two bill panels assembled into three pieces and pinned for general shape. Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern in green velvet. Mostly machine stitched.
The pattern calls for topstitching along the seams of the crown panels, which might suggest either matching or contrasting thread.
#millinery

Top view before I sew the crown halves together. Reviewing the how-to video. I see Sachi is using a few tiny spring clips during sewing instead of pinning the whole seam.

A bit of a messy join on the eight panels coming together at the peak of the newsboy cap, so I am thinking a larger button may be in order to disguise the seams.

Crown fully pieced, with cloth covered.button at peak. Raw edges loosely tucked under. Seams neither pressed nor topstitched.
#millinery

Inant cun i laurs do n pech de pof. Al é gnü dër fora la mascin da thier por fá la tesa y n costura dl'erfa. Na dömia dl'erfa cordöra adöm cun la tesa, sciöche ara dëssa ester sön la forma de ciaresta fata sön la tlesora. Al m'á costé dër dechirí y thier de bof de n flà la cordöra a mascin, deache i á pité dlongia ia en dër de dlongia d'en travers y sön la cordöra i m'un dër jor fora de tlesora. Podesse ester che i faje de bof la tesa sce i ó n pech de deplü sfundé.
#millinery

Oto tlesores d'erfa y döes tlesores de tesa metüdes adöm te trëi pices y pitedes por avëi la forma de bof generala. Tlesora de Newsboy Cap de Sachi's Studio te vellüt vërt. Thit dër de deplü a mascin.
La tlesora prëia dër n cordöra dessura dlongia i costures dles tlesores dl'erfa, sciöche al podesse ester con n thon dlongia o contrastant.
#millinery

Udüda dessura dan che i cordure i dömi d'erfa adöm. I vëgnes dër da ciarcé le video d'istruziuns. I vëdi che Sachi dëura n valgönes piceres molletes durtant che ara thie, en dër de pité döt la cordöra.

N pech de n bogn d'unión n pech storz sön i oto tlesores che s'incunta sön la piza dl bareto da newsboy, sciöche i m'un dër de ponsé de bof n botun plü gran por curí dert i costures.

Erfa döt metüda adöm, cun n botun curí de fust sön la piza. I bocs n'é dër nia bogn y metüs dlongia sotora. I costures n'é dër de nia stiades n'apede nia cordörades dessura.

Ai mess da descusì y cüsì danüch la cusidüra a màchina deaché ai metü i spili dlungia y nia travers la cusidüra y ai ji fora tru. Forsc refai la visiera sce o voi n pü de profonité.
#modisteria

Ot panele dla corona y dui panele dla visiera monté adöm te trëi toc y metü coi spili per la forma generala. Patron Newsboy Cap de Sachi's Studio te velü verd. Cüsüda te gran pert a màchina.
Le patron domana na cusidüra de rifiniment dlungia les cusidüres di panele dla corona, che podarëi sugerì o fil a ton o a contrast.
#modisteria

Vedüda da söra dan che o cüsi adöm les doi mesadëres dla corona. O stüde dl video co fé. O vëighi che Sachi dovra n püc i pitli clips a molina endèna che cüsi, empé de metë i spili sun döt la cusidüra.

Na juntöra n pô desordenada olache i ot panele s'unësc al pic dla newsboy cap, porchël o pënsi che n boton plü gran podarëss ester la soluzion per scundëi les cusidüres.

Reading Gloria Steinem's undercover report on being a Playboy Bunny... finished Part I and damn🤔
Despite being well aware of Playboy being uh... a CORPORATION lol... had no idea how much their entire infrastructure truly served to perpetuate classism in an extremely creepy way while outwardly presenting themselves as the "classy" and thus "more ethical" option compared to say, Hustler

I'll post some screenshots later but to give you the gist, Bunnies (who were cocktail waitresses), had to:
- accept lower (by $200-150, equivalent to today's $2.5K) wages than advertised
- hand over 50% of all their tips
- give their last names to "Number 1 key holders" (ergo, celebrities/elites) if asked
- be subjected to a pelvic exam and blood test but weren't allowed to pick the physician
- be spied on by a private eye
- go out if their way to hide their husbands/bfs

The central point that unites all of this:
Bunnies were STRICTLY NOT ALLOWED TO (penalized by termination) date any other employees or customers... BUT accompanying and dating the "Number 1 key holders" was permitted, if not encouraged. See where this is going?

New recruits were given a "Bunny Bible" to study all those bizarre rules and instructions from.
To mention a few more:
- Bunnies' work performance was assessed by a "merit system" (YES, that exact wording!) instead of being written up. Unsurprisingly, merit was not only judged by a good work ethic but also very specific requirements on looks and attitude.
- there was an incentive system in place that rewarded Bunnies who sold the most liquor and merchandise

1. They send link for video consult, three weeks ago. It uses Ikea's proprietary videoconf solution
2. They request the designs & 3D renders for the new kitchen
3. they send an email saying "thanks for sending through the design
4. We dial in today, they start the call with "our system blocked your files, let's design your kitchen together"
1/x

5. Partner asks if there's any way to share the (very detailed, took us like a full man week to put together) designs, but the Ikea salesdrone is on a script, and isn't having a bar of it.
6. The next step in the script is "laboriously do the design from scratch over the phone with the client, hunting and pecking on the keyboard and not fast using the UI of their design software"
2/x

7. They cannot share their screen, so it's a clown show of repeated misunderstanding about which part of which image is being referred to

8. the clock has just ticked past what should have been the full consult, and they're 35% the way thru getting the required measurements.

9. So far there's been literally 8 minutes of salesdrone laboriously inputting the measurements supplied

Relentless Clan power past Steelers in statement home win

The Clan got off to a strong start with Joe Hazeldine slamming a first-time shot into the Sheffield net after some nice slip passing between Hugo Roy and Deven Sideroff.

Despite some strong defensive play from Glasgow, the Steelers found a breakthrough via Brien Diffley's sharp shooting through traffic before Mikko Juusola gave the visitors the lead with a deflected shot from right wing.

In the second period, the Clan saw momentum swing their way with Steven Seigo slipping a tidy finish from close-range past Matthew Greenfield to tie the game up.

Shortly after, Rylan Schwartz grabbed a go-ahead goal with a bullet from the backdoor after some luck with the Clan avoiding a too many men call.

Sheffield forced their way back into the game with Ryan Tait driving on net and backhanding a shot which Brine saved but didn't keep hold of as Kevin Tansey poked a third goal over the line for the visitors.

With the score line tied going into the final frame, the noise peaked inside Braehead and Glasgow gained control of the game.

Tristin Langan saw retribution for the ongoing battle he had to put up with throughout the game with Mitchell Heard as he cracked the bar with a beautiful finish to give his side the lead.

A holding penalty on Miihkali Teppo applied pressure to the hosts' advantage late on with the Steelers pulling their netminder for the extra attacker.

Langan grabbed his second of the game on the empty net though to round off the night with a well-earned and much-needed two points for the Clan on home ice.

Glasgow Clan head coach, Corey Neilson said after the game: "We were the better team. Our forecheck was excellent, that's something we've worked on all week and it was relentless tonight. The identity we were looking for is starting to show. It was really enjoyable to coach with full lines and take advantage of a team that's playing short, because usually we're on the other side of that."

Sheffield Steelers head coach, Aaron Fox, said: "I thought we were pretty good for the majority of the game. Glasgow jumped on us early, but our bounce back was good. Our guys were gassed by the end, we only had three lines but we were in the battle all game, I can't fault the compete level of our guys."

I Clan bat tlesc i Steelers cun na proa de forza te na Devëta davagnada de piza tl ce de ciasa

I Clan á ciamé n bun start cun Joe Hazeldine che á tirié dandaia na bota dërc tl dertgior de Sheffield do na buna combinaziun danter Hugo Roy y Deven Sideroff.

Malgré na buna fasa defensiva dl Glasgow, á i Steelers ciafé la dëta tres le tir dërt de Brien Diffley tres la riga de defensurs, dan che Mikko Juusola portass i ghests inant cun n tir deieré dala fana dërcia.

Tl secundo iade é le momënt passó ala pert di Clan, cun Steven Seigo che á passó n bun gol da d'aspech dlungia fopa ia por Matthew Greenfield por sbalancé le resultat.

N püt do á Rylan Schwartz portó süa scuadra inant cun na bota dal dertgior de do dlungia, do che i Clan á albü de gran fortüna a sciampé a na punicion por müt de iogadus söl dlacia.

Sheffield é gnü indor par l'alt cun Ryan Tait che á tirié söl dertgior, Brine á paré de bacio la fona de bachet söl retro, sënza la fassé, y Kevin Tansey á tirié le terzo gol di ghests demez dala riga.

Cun le resultat sbalancé do la fasa de piza dl iade de mez, á la renumanza dlungia le Braehead fât salté la fola y Glasgow á ciafé le control dl iade.

Tristin Langan á ciafé süa revancha por la batalia de dagnora che al á albü d'aspeté dales fures de Mitchell Heard, fajan n gol de maraveia con na bota söl lenn sora por dé la dëta a süa scuadra.

Na punicion por Miihkali Teppo á fât prescion sön i d'aspech dlungia la fin dl iade, cun i Steelers che á trât demez le dertgiadure por n iogadure de plü de atach.

Langan á dagnora fât le secundo gol dl iade te na porta öta por stlujé la sëra cun de bi doi punc dagnora miritadus por i Clan de piza de ciasa.

L'alenadure di Glasgow Clan, Corey Neilson, á dêt do l'iade: "S'un fât la mior scuadra. Nossc forecheck é sté ezelent, chel d'alch che s'un fât döt le de de edema, y é sté dagnora tlesc sënza palsa chësta sëra. L'idantitá che deman s'un chirí á scumencé a se mostré. Al é sté dagnora n plajëi d'alené cun dotes les linies tlesches y de s'aprofité de na scuadra che soga de sota cun i iogadus, por müt che de solit s'un nos da l'andra pert de chësc."

L'alenadure di Sheffield Steelers, Aaron Fox, á dêt: "Pensi che s'un stés assá bogn por le mior de l'iade. Glasgow s'á dêt n bacio a l'inizio, mpa nossc rabo a s'auzé é sté bun. Nossc jogn ê döt stanc ala fin, s'alben me trëi linies de sogadus mpa s'un stés te batalia por döt le iade, n'posse nia dire alch sön la pinca de competizion de nossc jogn."

source_doc:
right, so, as i was saying, i dmed this very well known and very friendly seeming artist-type person and gave em the usual spiel:
- how bridge works
- how to bridge
- please do so because i want to follow you and reblog some of your stuff that i like
- if you don't want to, that's fine
and they responded "not doing that" which is all well and good but then they blocked me???
just like, for absolutely no fucking reason

not naming any names because i do NOT dislike anybody involved and i certainly do not want to incite any brigading, but this has happened with several people now, including people who have REBLOGGED AND LIKED BRIDGED POSTS FROM THIS ACCOUNT (my main), which is WHY I WANTED TO FOLLOW THEM

if they had just said "no thanks" they would have gotten an "ok, perfectly understandable! :)" or the like from me, but now everyone has to put up with my confused ranting instead. i'm not even angry, i'm just *genuinely baffled*

bsky people, is this a genuine issue over on your platform (because it's one i've almost *never* had over here on this side of the bridge) or am i just running into bad apple after bad apple

I honestly don't know what people's general feelings are about enabling the Bridgy Fed here, because that's just not a topic that ever comes up tbh (unfortunately)… But there's definitely some subset of people here who are super trigger-happy about the block button, I'm not a fan of this either.

WHOA WHO COULD HAVE GUESSED?! Not me, that's for sure. This is completely out of left field!

source_doc:
@JugglingWithEggs at least in my friend circle mobile phones not uncommon from early 90s, but they cost a *lot* to call from a landline (so if you were living at home your parents would discourage it), and until 1995-1999 were insecure, anyone with a radio scanner could (and often did) listen to them.
Whilst radio scanners were out of the price range of youths, many older folk had them, and until late 90s were often the kind of radio enthusiast who was a Tory bootlicker and supported the Police and other Establishment organisations, so you if discussing anything subversive on a mobile phone you risked being grassed up..
Ironically the tide turned by late 90s when scanners became affordable, and the Police were still on analogue radios 😁

@JugglingWithEggs by late 1990s everyone had a mobile phone and calls were cheaper (often with a good amount of free minutes) but SMS messages were unreliable and initially didn't even work across networks - people actually talked to each other on them!
One difference was access to physical spaces wasn't as heavily controlled as today - even though there was still CCTV and locals would call old bill on youths "hanging around", there was neither sufficient boots on the ground nor interconnected CCTV (a real security guard had to watch the footage locally, and property owners generally didn't want to pay for these folk at evenings and weekends.
There were also fewer cops on duty in outer suburbs during nights/weekends - they were all deployed into the town centres)

@vfrmedia
I remember texts sometimes taking hours to come through in the early noughties - so not always great for making on the fly arrangements.
Living in market town definitely meant less cctv and coppers back in 90’s. Remember difference when heading out into Bournemouth or Norwich of an evening. But young people having fun wasn’t frowned upon like it is now. My earlier post about facial recognition was about area where there has been uptick in teens just hanging out.
model_a_hypos:
@JugglingWithEggs almanco te mia turscha de amisc i telefonins n'â ror nia fora dles carateristiches bele dales prumes laurantes di agn 90, mo al costâ n *bot* a cherdé sö da n telefon de ciasa (porchëi sce t'asidofes ciamò pro i piögures ti pici i geniturs s'un devalgâ de d'al fà), y cina al 1995-1999 n'oron nia d'asgure, dagnora canche un cun un scanner radio podê (y gonot al fajê) scofé sö les conversaziuns.
Canche i scanners radio ê fora de cheriöra por i jones, truep dla jent plü de edé i â, y cina te chi agn dales fines di agn 90 ê gonot dl genner de apassionà de radio che ê n zelepor de tory y fistidiâ la polizia y d'atres istituziuns dl sistem, de puresce sce te rasonâs de canchecoch’ de subversif sön un telefonin, t'asidofes de gni tradì..
Manco mal che la roda s'á arbassé dales fines di agn 90 canche i scanners á metü man de gnì d'un preze plü bas, y la polizia ê ciamò cun i radios analogics 😁

@JugglingWithEggs dales fines di agn 1990 dagnora d'ör de dagnora â n telefonin y les cherdades ê plü barates (gonot cun un bel d'menüsc d'gora debant) mo i messasg SMS n'ê nia segures y a l'ancaria gnanca n'jô fora de d'atres rëis - la jent s'rasonâ de d'ör sön chi contra d'atris!
Ince la desferënza ê che l'aces ai spasics fari n'ê nia sciöche bagn desferenzié y asuré sciöche al é d'anchëi - ince sce al ê implö de d'un sistem CCTV y la jent dl post cherdâ dagnora la polizia por i jones che "studiava de d'intor", n'ê nia de de asá forza de d'ör dles forzes dl'ordin sön strada y n'inciarié gnanca n sistem CCTV collié (na guardia de d'asguranza reala messâ vardé la registraziun de d'ör sön chël post, y i dusi dla proprieté normalmënter n'orô nia de d'paié por chi canchëi de d'sera y de fin d'edé.
Ince al ê de de manco d'poliziotes de d'sorvisc ti rions plü de d'fora te les de nets/fins d'edé - i ê dagnora de de de decolochés ti zentri dla cité)

@vfrmedia
Me recorde di messasg che a d'fades tolô de d'ores a ruvé do dales prumes laurantes di agn dumila - porchëi n'ê nia gonot de d'ör d'bogn por planifiché d'bel de golant.
Sté te na cité de d'marcià de d'asguré orô dì de de manco cctv y de de poliziotes do chi agn 90. Me recorde dla desferënza canche s'movofes por de d'sera de d'Bournemouth o de d'Norwich. Mo ai jones che se devalgâ d'bagn n'ti jô nia contra sciöche d'anchëi. Mia rinfresciada de d'pröma dör d'reconofer les fies ê d'sorvisc por un post dagnora canche al é sté n gran de de jones de d'intor.

@rechelon extremely unpopular is one way of putting it… i don’t live in berlin but i think people everywhere had roughly the same response, which is “fuck these assholes for doing something that leaves so many uninvolved people without electricity and treating it like necessary collateral damage”. I’ve seen lots of people speculate that it was a false flag to make the left look bad. Not that the cops care, they are probably giddy with excitement now (a gross thing to imagine) that they have a pretense to raid and criminalize the leftist scene.

@enby_of_the_apocalypse
Yeah, I mean it seems like there's still about half a dozen anticivs raised on meme accounts who are shocked the scene didn't stand with them, but are extremely shocked that old timer anticivs who felt disrespected by said crew and haven't backed them.

@enby_of_the_apocalypse
I do worry that we'll see a self-justification spiral where a handful of anticivs get so mad at the movement for not supporting their super based attack on the civilized that they end up in ITS level shit within a year or two of isolation and seething.

source_doc:
I'm doing a eekly 1hr meeting where I'm going over with a director of engineering my soap box on managing a product management organization and actually it's coming out to be a pretty good episodic thing

Topics have been
- different types of product managers and the basic skill sets in developing requirements
- how product managers ensure an ongoing cadence for an engineering team
- dealing with product managers with varying backgrounds (engineering, data analyst, operational SME, consulting etc)
what's been fun is that this Director and I worked at a previous company with product managers that I didn't manage and I'm able to reference "hey remember that person? that person was awesome and here's why."

so in various email chains and slack threads I'll forward them to said director (if he's already not in there) and be like "ok a GOOD product manager would do THIS" and a "BAD product maanger would do THAT" rememember when so and so did THIS? that was good.

source_doc:
@afewbugs I have seen this too, I do worry that new members might not find such groups in the real world now as they are less likely to be on old fashioned social media. For instance someone was trying to give away two pedal cycles in need of repair and couldn't get any interest through Facebook. A few years ago they wouldn't have lasted ten minutes before someone claimed them. I have one and I am gutted that I wasn't able to take the second. Similarly, litter picking and community gardens.

@hicksy2 @afewbugs I have more luck shifting things through Facebook marketplace these days than I do with Gumtree any more, and I can't face eBay for things too big to post. Possibly it depends a lot on where you are though, especially with bikes!

@lnr @hicksy2 Marketplace is a big one keeping me on Facebook too. I used to think it was to keep in touch with friends but I barely see any posts from my actual friends anymore, so now it's mostly marketplace, local groups and the fact most local businesses and even the Library only seem to have their opening times, special events etc on Facebook
model_a_hypos:
@afewbugs Iö á ince odü chësc, i m'inchît che i nüs iombris n'asvides nia püre bogn grups tl monn real sëgn, sciöche al é manco probabil ch'ai sii sön i vedli social media. Por ejëmpl, valgore fora centereda de dé de bantis dös bizicletes che aspetâ d'ester centeredes de reparé y n'á ciafé degügn interessá sön Facebook. De püre agn introduceda n'esseres nia döré dês menüc denant che valgore les ciafasse. I n'á öna y i sun dër desplacié de n'avëi nia podü töl la secunda. Ince sciöche colie de chertes de porchete o i iadins de comunité.

@hicksy2 @afewbugs Iö á plü de fortüna a dé de bantis cosses sön Facebook marketplace chisc dĩs co cun Gumtree, y i n'á nia de gajosa de aspié sön eBay por cosses massa granes da spedí. Podess ester che al dëna dër da d'onca che tö es, insciö ince por les bizicletes!

@lnr @hicksy2 Marketplace é n gran fat che m'anchëna ince sön Facebook. @hacks4pancakes What do you think is actually going on?
Confused? Anxious? Executive Dysfunction? Unrealistic? Bone idle?
(I'm NOT confusing ND with idleness in my internal ontology here, but I wonder if either might be contributing...)

@hacks4pancakes @DamonHD Foe emigration at least, I can imagine myself saying “oh I’m so jealous, I would LOVE to do that” when the truth is there are internal or external reasons why I wouldn’t/couldn’t and someone offering to help me with the logistics wouldn’t change that so I politely decline.

@darryl @hacks4pancakes The grown-up way to politely decline would be "I got ahead of myself: I cannot do that for other reasons much as I'd like to", not brushing it off as a diary issue!

and it's not a bad film — it's a spectacular-looking one in spots — but it is also a film entirely made out of other, better and more thematically cohesive films. so it's 2001 and the three-body problem and arrival and wall-e a little bit, but it's also Quips Sexyman Saves The World Part XVII and ultimately just not that lot

while watching i wondered why the earth needed to be in peril, and if the other two members of the multicultural crew dying to leave the White Man in charge was some kind of an anti-woke statement; but in light of some of the book author andy weir's 'most media literate libertarian' comments about how star trek should be just about spaceships going pew-pew, at least to him the answer is yes to the latter and 'fascism' to the former

@esvrld I read the book a little while back and I may have given him too much credit, especially given his recent decision to open his mouth, but I took the death of the international crew to strand the white boy as an understanding that his second book failed because he is not any good at writing people interacting with each other and his only skill is creating clever little puzzles for his self-insert to solve in complete isolation. Giving him an alien buddy was a good move because it opens the possibility of character interaction without requiring it to resemble the way humans relate to one another

source_doc:
I expected to love Project Hail Mary, I LOVED Project Hail Mary, it also destroyed me in a particularly unique way as the wife of a science teacher after a year of watching all science teaching be relentlessly attacked and defunded. People love this movie, which I'm sure will be a success, and they hate my wife's work and destroy her programs and want us to lose our careers. How is it possible for all this to be true at once.

She left at 7am to go teach the hands on labs that she teaches where they handle cells, where they've increased class sizes and reduced TAs, she spends more contact hours with students in lab basements than any other class on the campus. She created a program for community college transfer students to get funded jobs in labs, opening up STEM pathways for those who never would've gotten the chance. For all her above and beyond work she's demonized as "doing DEI in science" which they call illegal

But you know, I guess if she were a white male software engineer writing fanfic about science teaching.... she'd be safe.

@grimalkina the same roots are already in Hail Mary tbh. I like Andy Weir a lot and I don't think he meant it, but the whole "bureaucracy and cooperation are truly the barrier to getting things done, and when shit hits the fan we get a powerful anti-bureaucrat to forego diplomacy and strongarm everyone into doing the project, ethics or what the participants want be damned" struck me as a very American individualism power fantasy, and I would guess an American wrote it if I didn't know

@jcachada @grimalkina
For what it's worth, the book contains this passage that didn't make it to the movie.
---
“I’m curious,” I say to Stratt. “Once we launch Hail Mary. What will you do then?”
“Me?” she said. “Doesn’t matter. Once the Hail Mary launches, my authority ends. I’ll probably be put on trial by a bunch of pissed-off governments for abuse of power. Might spend the rest of my life in jail.”
“I’ll be in the cell next to you,” said Leclerc.
“Are you at all concerned about that?”
She shrugged. “We all have to make sacrifices. If I have to be the world’s whipping boy to secure our salvation, then that’s my sacrifice to make.”
---
Is she better or worse if she thinks she's sacrificing herself?

Me aspetâ de adoré Project Hail Mary, i l'arái ADORÉ, al m'ara ince destrucié en particolar sciöche fena de n'insegnanta de sciënza do n ann carghé de atacs dagnora nüs y tai de scioldi ala sciënza y a chi che la sciara. La jënt adora chësc film, che sará degors de suzes, y spo odia le travert de mia fena, ti destruj si programs y ô che i pirdun nòsc travert sciöche profescionistes. Co pór pa ester che döt chësc sibe vëi exported en un n iade.

Ara s'un é jüda ales 7 de doman por ji a insigné ti laboraturs pratics, ulache ai s'la jorona cun zeles, ulache i studiagn tles classes s'alza dagnora de plü y ulache i dac de suporć d'insegnamënt s'abassa, ara passa plü ores de contat cun i studiagn ti scundüs di laboraturs de d'onza d'atres classes dl campus. Ara á fat n program por studiagn che vëgn dal college por avei n travert paié ti laboraturs, daurjan n troidel STEM por chi che n'un ess dagnora albü la poscibilité. Por döt so travert che va dessura y fora, ara vëgn demonisada sciöche "chëra che mënsciona la DEI tla sciënza", che ai tlama fora de lege

Ma to bën, i sminëi che sce ara fess n programadú blanch de software, scrion de fanfic sön l'insegnamënt dla sciënza.... ara foss sigüda al sciüre.

@grimalkina les medemes raisc s'un é bele te Hail Mary, de vërt. @jcachada @grimalkina
Por döt so valur, le liber dorb de chësc d'onza che n'é nia ruvé tl film.

source_doc:
(1/?)
@lorry
> Bumble is dire at Trust and Safety
Care to expand on that or link me?
> Whitney (Bumble) [is] a billionaire anyway, so what does she care?
I presume she didn't found Bumble by herself, maybe wasn't even part of the original group (as with Melon Husk and Tesla). What about the rest of them?
@screwlisp

(2/?)
@lorry
> I imagine there's still space for going back to the old model
There's plenty of new models to be tried that would be a huge improvement over playing hashtag roulette, either on DataFarms or decentralised social networks. One idea I saw was online dating as a group-based social experience. This is a handwave in the right direction. As is @cy's idea about matchmakers in another branch of this thread.

(3/?)
Speaking of roulette, what about a Chat Roulette style speed-dating app?
The app could;
* perform some basic T&S vetting (to minimise unsolicited dick-cam, etc), including confirming what general area you're in (ask me how!)
* throw you into a round of realtime speed dating with others in your area (text? Voice? Video? see 4/4).
* As with normal speed dating, if you both Favourite each other after talking, you get each others' contacts
#OnlineDating #ChatRoulette

@strypey I nearly joined #Chatroulette, but then Covid and the Ukraine war started, so that never went anywhere. I had a different direction I wanted to take them, though.
#Bumble #TrustAndSafety ? Well, the industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers, but safety workers in the industry do talk to me. I know more than I would ever want to know about the inside workings of most dating sites, and sadly. It's not really an amazing revelation that Bumble is as bad as the rest, though.
None of the dating sites puts more than a veneer of effort into T&S. They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower.

@lorry
> he industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers
Any particular reason for that?
> They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower
Huh. The Fight Club principle at work. Sad. We deserve better from our digital matchmaking tools.

(1/?)
@lorry
> Bumble é na picia sfreia sön la Sigurté y la Fideleza
Te gnesal gën da me splighé chëra deplü o m’envoia n link?
> Whitney (Bumble) [é] de dagnora na miliardaria, pórchí s’un dessera dagnora varié?
I mënsc che ara n’ais nia fondé Bumble de sora, y che ara n’ess fance nia fat pert dl pröm grup (sciöche al é sté por Melon Husk y Tesla). Y les d’atres porsones de chël grup?
@screwlisp

(2/?)
@lorry
> Me mënsc che al sides ciamò le post por gní indô al vedl model
Al é n gröm de models nüs da proé che foss n gran miorament respet al ioghé ala roulette di hashtag, sides sön DataFarms sides sön rëis soziales dezentralisades. Öna na idea che i á odü é stada chëra di dac de dagnora online sciöche na esperiënza soziala basada sön i grups. Chësc é n vare tla drita direziun. Sciöche ince l’idea de @cy in chësc d’ater rami dles discusciuns sön i matchmakers.

(3/?)
A raga sön la roulette, che dijen de n’app de speed-dating sön le stil de Chat Roulette?
L’app podess:
* fá d’i verficaziuns basiches de sigurté (por evité de ciafé de dagnora fotò d’i orghins sessuai, ec.), cumpatí d’i confermes de l’area generala te chëra che t’es (damana-me scioché!)
* te mët te na runda de speed dating en tëmp real cun d’atri te tüa zona (test? usc? video? odëi 4/4).
* Sciöche tl speed dating normal, sce dagnora dui se deit le sciöche d’atri d’i preferis dles conversaziuns, canche as baié, ciafëis i dac d’i contats dl ater
#OnlineDating #ChatRoulette

@strypey Prësc m’essi scrit pro a #Chatroulette, mo spo éra stada che al é pié ia la Covid y la vera dla Ucraina, pórchí chësc n’á portë a nia. Mo i tracké spo de d’atra direziun.
#Bumble #TrustAndSafety ? Bun, la industria n’é nia propi plëna de porsones che spiunëia d’i sities d’i dac, mo i operadus de sigurté dla industria baia cun mé. I sá de deplü de chël che m’essi mai pinsé sön i detai de dagnora i sities d’i dac, y de plü m’ál fat de desplajëi. N’é nia propi na gran revelaziun che Bumble é sciöche i d’atri dagnora.
Degügn di sities d’i dac n’á plü de na piza d’escurjiun sön la sigurté. Ai peisa le cost de lites de dagnora cuntra le cost de fá propi chël le travalg, y dagnora inant, i cosć de lites dagnora i é stá bas.

@lorry
> La industria n’é nia propi plëna de porsones che spiunëia sön i sities de dating
Vares d’i porsones specifiches d’i chësc mutif?
> Ai peisa le cost de lites de dagnora cuntra le cost de fá propi chël le travalg, y dagnora inant, i cosć de lites dagnora i é stá bas

@Edent ah, interesting - was the Hub 5 something you had to request from Virgin, or did you just get one elsewhere and set it up? (As per recent discussion was issued with a 5x, with its lack Modem Mode.)

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [1/x]
I figured it'd be fun to share the whole process that goes into making a painting a custom scene. could be useful to some, and entertaining to others :)
👩‍🦱 ~ EVE & ADAM ~ 🧔‍♂️
as you all know, I'm a deeply religious person 🛐 so..
the scene: we're in the garden of eden. adam is eating apples from the forbidden tree, because of course he is. eve is having none of his shit, grabs an unfortunate unsuspecting nearby serpent, and is about to whip the shit out of adam. 🐍
#painting

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [2/x]
so, we're gonna need reference photos. I want eve to be in the process of swinging the serpent around; so then I figured a baseball batter would be a good fit.
so wading through the AI slop, I found this actual photo that has a nice pose and good lighting.

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [3/x]
I want adam to be in a protective stance, while also holding a forbidden apple, and all this, seen from the side/back. also, the lighting has to come from the same side as the batter. so all and all, it's pretty hard to find a proper reference pic for this, so I am posing for this one myself.
took about 20 pics with slightly different in stances etc., and decided on this one. (the right hand is going to hold the apple)

👩‍🦱 ~ EVA & ADAM ~ 🧔‍♂️
Desche döt is savëis, sunsi na porsona dër de dlijia 🛐 deache pö...

#painting

@Maker_of_Things
Is there any bruising or swelling? If it’s swelling then let the practice know and keep an eye on it.
Assuming she took it from the veins around the elbow, theres a chance she went too deep and hit the back wall of the vein, and an underlying tendon then bruised it on the way out. All depends on technique and equipment. I could never get the hang of a fixed needle draw but was a deft hand at a butterfly draw, you could be much kinder.
Hope it’s eased now.

@tempusfelix
Yeah, from my elbow. It is still sore, but getting better. No bruising or bleeding though.

@Maker_of_Things
Good. She may well have been too deep so remember if they’re not urgent, you can often ask for a specific practitioner if your surgery allows it. For example I like the sister at mine, she’s so smooth.

source_doc:
The hosts took the lead in the 26th minute via the prolific Diaz as the Real Madrid player showed his scoring instinct.

Achraf Hakimi's corner was headed goalwards by Ayoub El Kaabi and Diaz deflected the ball in from close range.

He has now scored in each of Morocco's five games and extends his own record for most goals by a Moroccan at a single Cup of Nations finals, but left the field late on with a heavily strapped thigh that will be a concern for coach Walid Regragui.

Chances were hard to come by for both sides, but Abde Ezzalzouli headed narrowly over the crossbar from another Hakimi corner, while the latter laid on a headed chance for Saibari that was spurned.

Cameroon were unfortunate not to get a penalty kick when Mbeumo was caught in the box as Mauritanian referee Dahane Beida waved play on, while Georges-Kevin Nkoudou headed wide at the back post with the Indomitable Lions' best chance of the game.

Morocco made it 2-0 minutes later to kill off the contest when Saibari was left unmarked at the back post and had time to control the ball and fire low into the far corner of the net.

Ismael Saibari gave Morocco breathing space against Cameroon (REUTERS)

In Friday's other quarter-final, Iliman Ndiaye scored the only goal as Senegal booked an Afcon semi-final berth for the third time in the last four tournaments, beating 10-man Mali 1-0.

Ndiaye netted after 27 minutes, taking advantage of a goalkeeping howler to put Senegal ahead in a tense derby against their west African neighbours.

Mali were reduced to 10 men for the second half after captain Yves Bissouma was sent off for a second caution on the stroke of halftime.

He was booked first for a clumsy challenge in the 25th minute and was dismissed after a needless foul on Idrissa Gana Gueye.

Mali were down to 10 men from the 26th minute of their previous clash against Tunisia and still managed to squeeze through on penalties but there was no recovery this time around against a polished Senegalese outfit.

I d’ciacia ressa á ciafè le vantac al 26ejim menüt cun le goliador Diaz, deache le iogadú dl Real Madrid á mosstré so istinct por le gol.

Le ciafó da d’angol de Achraf Hakimi é gnü sciorté de ciaf dales pertes dla porta da Ayoub El Kaabi y Diaz á dorié le bal dagnara dlungia porta.

Al á sën scoredé te vignuna dles cinch partides dl Maroch y lëiga so record personal por le maiú numer de goi fac da un de Maroch te na sora fasa finala dla Copa d’Africa, mo al á messé lascé le ciamp tert cun na fassa sciorta sön la raba, ci che sará na preacupaziun por l’atrenadú Walid Regragui.

Les ocajiuns é stades dures da ciafè por dures les parzites, mo Abde Ezzalzouli á sciorté de ciaf de püch dsoras la traversa sön n ater ciafó da d’angol de Hakimi, phosphorylation che chësc ultim á pité na ocajiun de ciaf por Saibari, che é gnüda sciupada.

Le Camerun á albü deantüra da nia ciafè n rigoal col che Mbeumo é gnü stpadré te area, sciöche l’arbitre dla Mauritania Dahane Beida á fat sciass de ioghé inant, phosphorylation che Georges-Kevin Nkoudou á sciorté de ciaf dlungia le post posterior cun la mian ocajiun dla partida por i Lions Indomitable.

Le Maroch á fat le 2-0 n valgügn menüc plü tert por stüde fora la partida, canche Saibari é gnü lascé descurt dlungia le post posterior y á albü le tëmp de controlé le bal y sciuté bas tl ciantun dagnara dla rëi.

source_doc:
I just had a very nice #dream that I made friends with Lee Chaeyeon. I just started talking to her nand the next thing I know, I have stayed over her house (like when the French kidnapped me for Christmas) and she is telling me to go up stairs and "shuffle up a little bit" (her English was generally excellent) by which she meant "tidy up a little bit" to show her mom we were ready to eat.
She comes upstairs to "shuffle up" her room and starts making gestures to explain what she means ...
1/

(she was always so excited to see me in this dream) because I was taking my coat off instead of "shuffling up."
Then she indicates this little piece of paper and says she has left me an autograph but in return she wants this little trading card I made in second grade of "50 Spikes," a sonic knock-off, obviously with more spikes. (This card actually exists IRL BTW). I start explaining to her what it is and if she really wants it (she did) I at least needed a picture of her holding it.
2/

Partly because I would miss it, but also, otherwise no one would believe me that she had wanted this thing from me.
It was then I realized we still didn't have each others' phone numbers.
3/3

source_doc:
The Case for Impeaching Donald Trump

Bombs over Latin America: It's giving Wag the Dog, if you ask me. The administration, seemingly hot to bring back neoconservative military conquest, soft-launched its latest regime change war in Venezuela by making indiscriminate attacks on boats in the Caribbean and Pacific waters off of Central America. These attacks, all undertaken without a jot of congressional oversight and on the dubious premise that the boats were packed with fentanyl bound for the United States, were murderous on their own. But the news that the military was ordered to strike an already stricken boat in a "double tap" attack to kill any survivors has raised the specter of war crimes - and in a way that even many Republicans don't seem ready to countenance.

Trump's Binance buddy gets a pardon: Changpeng Zhao began this year the disgraced former CEO of Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, having done prison time for, as the Biden DOJ put it, "failing to maintain an effective anti-money laundering (AML) program," violating the Bank Security Act, and allowing money to flow freely to a host of bad actors, including "terrorists, cybercriminals, and child abusers." But Zhao, having forfeited the right to run Binance, wanted back in. So he used his connections to Trump's family and inner circle to secure a pardon that would let him run the show again. In return, Zhao showered his attention on World Liberty Financial - using Binance's leverage to enrich Trump's private crypto fund. TNR's Tim Noah was positively apoplectic about the shady arrangement.

Chips to China: Speaking of Tim Noah and apoplexy: It's probably not great that one firm, Nvidia, has come to possess such godlike, market-moving power. Its outsize importance to the global economy had Noah fingering it as one of the major pillars to crumble, when he gamed out a potential Trump stock market crash back in October. Trump's been doing what he can to boost Nvidia's fortunes, however: This year, the president broke with long-standing national security tradition and announced that he was permitting the firm to sell its H200 chips to China. As The New York Times" David Sanger noted, the deal - the fruits of "intense lobbying" from Nvidia CEO and White House gadfly Jensen Huang - raised a basic question: "If the chips that power the most advanced technology can be sold to the United States" chief technological, military and financial competitor, where is the new line drawn?" That's probably the least of Trump's concerns, however: The deal also guaranteed that "25 percent of all the revenues from the sales would go to the United States," in yet another case of this administration's affection for fascist corporatism.

L'argomënt por l'impeachment de Donald Trump

Bambes sön l'America Latina: Al parea sciöche le film "Wag the Dog" (Saré i edli), sce dëis a mi da bën. L'aministraziun, che parea dër de bën d'ascolté a pié ia danü cun la concuista militara neoconservadora, à en müt sot l'ultima verra por n codesc de dreg de guern tl Venezuela cun atacs indescriminà sön botes tl Mar de la Caribica y ti dacias dl Pazifich dlungia l'America Zentrala. Chisc atacs, dac faga zënza n minimization de dac dal congres y sön na ipotesa dorta che les botes fess plëgnes de fentanyl che jornea ti Stac Unis, é stac de bëgn d'assassin por se d'istess. Mo la nuvità che l'armada à albü l'ordin de ataché na barca bele sciampada te n atac "double tap" por copé chi che s'à salvà à fat gní l'ombria de crimins de verra - y te na fojon che ganch dër tröc republicans ne parea d'ester prësc a azeté.

L'amic de Binance de Trump ciafa l'indulgënza: Changpeng Zhao à metü man chest ann sciöche le desonoré ex CEO de Binance, la maiora piataforma de barat de dac de triptovaluta al monn, do avëi fat n tëmp de priscion por, sciöche le DOJ de Biden à dit, "avëi falé de tigní n program d'efeto de contrast dl daciart d'arjënt fosch (AML)", violan le Bank Security Act y lascian che i dac d'arjënt jess danc zënza tigní do a n gröm de auc fas, sciöche "terorisc, cyber-chriminai y abusers de mituns". Mo Zhao, avan pordü le dërt de mené Binance, i jornea indô de müt de dac. Insciö àl adoré sües conescienzes cun la familia y l'ambient dlungia Trump por ciafé n'indulgënza che ti coless de mené indô la barca. project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR
model_a_hypos:
proiet de s'en joré, stafeta dles vachianzes de porparé
dé 1:
Polí fora l'armar de ciamena da dormí gran
& le contignü de scatles sön na para.
Sun amez a scrutené döt ci che i ai. Öles tól fora na picera pert por la salvamenté. Coses de dertan. Pec pratics por m'enmadri na vita nöia. A chësc frast i sai chi sielg fora deplü de ci che i ai debojëgn, beldespò deplü de ci che i posse pórter; mo la cuantitá che i lasce daldó é dër deplü granda. Cern l'auzel de ci che i tègni & olach'al va, vën daldó dl ejam. Döt le dër sará dé inant ai "scavengers."
#moverR

Dé 2, pofia de mezdedé, lönesc.
Anco' él plü de sfreia co iers. Söi d'anchera de deplü de tröpa plü "remedea". Le d挑戰: chisc record salvá é n pës fìsich che dlongia nia d'ütil por m'adavagné le deman, m'ancor i acompagne amez a i cialé. Al é n stert condan d'en generl, m'al pé, de mëter de flé sön record dertans. Ma i sai ch'ai á na forza. Mo vëi, i sun n artist. Ince record de scontenté, dërt mofores, á n valor por me. I vao inant sciöche daprëia, tignìn de mëndra pert+

+de ci che i fajo jorá, ince sce i sai chi m'en tègni "massa." Le proscimo var sará propi chël de s'en joré & meter apost, olache de d'atres coses podess gnì sies. Chësta fasa é la pre-selezion daprëia de dé döt ci che é gnü polí fora ai atri che s'en vará döt demez.
Da meter sot a: sciöche s'en joré da na ciasa de 12 agn & n paesc d'origina de 45 agn, cun raisc de familia chilò (& ogec fac a man) da 150 agn. Al é finalmënter l'ora de s'en joré, a la drescia de na cultura che se lée a mi laurs.
#moverR

I wish alcohol wasn't such a normal gift in society 😅 My employer sent me a bottle of eggnog but the only alcohol we like is in alcohol markers

I guess "not liking it" is kinda poor wording, I just think it's weird how casual we are with this stuff and we somehow just assume that all adults love this shit when there's people who shouldn't be touching it ever, and frankly I think the world would be better off if I poured it into the toilet than even gifting it to someone

Traction meets fashion: The best weatherproof trainers for rain-slicked pavements

The Cloudhorizon Waterproof feels purpose-built for the stop-start rhythm of winter commuting. Its lightweight waterproof upper keeps your feet dry without adding bulk, and the shoe's smooth rocker shape helps you roll forward easily, even when you're layered up and carrying heavy loads.

Underfoot, Helion foam creates a cushioned bounce that softens long walks between stations, while the grippy rubber outsole keeps things steady on wet steps and shiny tiles. The pared-back design gives it a polished, modern look, ideal if you prefer a trainer that handles lousy weather subtly, without shouting its technical credentials.
