source_doc:
US bound Thompson stars as Galway reach FBD final

California-bound Matthew Thompson lashed home 2-06 as Galway overcame Leitrim by 11 points in Tuam to book their spot in next week's FBD League decider.

2025 Young Footballer of the Year nominee Thompson will be out of action for the entirety of the league and the early part of the championship, with Padraic Joyce confirming that the Salthill-Knocknacarra players is studying in Berkeley for the upcoming semester.

He was the leading figure on a largely experimental Galway side - which also contained Cian Hernon and Kieran Molloy - as they came from three points down at half-time to beat Leitrim.

Thompson buried a goal in the top corner in the first half but the Connacht champions trailed Leitrim at the break, Killian Gaffney proving effective from placed balls, while Ryan O'Rourke and Jack Kelly also landed points.

Galway manager Padraic Joyce remonstrates with the referee over a decision

However, with Thompson converting a second half penalty, Galway eased home after the interval, with 10 different scorers overall as they ran out 2-19 to 0-14 winners.

After two rounds of the FBD League, the top two progress to next week's final, with Galway facing the winner of tomorrow's Roscommon-Mayo tie.

In Leinster, Westmeath have booked their spot in the O'Byrne Cup final after an 11-point win over Offaly in a goal-fest in Mullingar.

Waiting for them in the decider is a Kildare outfit that defeated Dublin 1-22 to 1-13.

Mark McHugh's Westmeath side advanced ahead of reigning champions Longford following a coin toss last Saturday but they impressed on the field of play on Saturday.

A brace of goals apiece from Danny McCarton and Brandon Kelly, plus another from Senan Baker, saw them run out 5-10 to 2-08 winners.

Ciaran Murphy scored two goals either side of half-time to pull the visitors back into the contest, the margin being briefly reduced to three points 11 minutes into the second half.

However, an unanswered burst of 3-02 over the next 15 minutes saw the hosts settle the contest in an emphatic manner.

Kildare found their feet in the second half against Dublin and now are one game away from a first O'Byrne Cup since 2014.

Harry O'Neill fires to the net for Kildare

Both management teams experimented in Newbridge with Dublin in particular shorn of overly familiar faces, but in the first half it seemed to matter little as they led 1-08 to 0-08 at the break.

Jamie McCarville palmed home their goal but it was Clyde Burke who caught the eye for the travelling support with some brilliant shooting that included two orange flags - the second of which was of the highest quality.

Alex Beirne was racking up the scores for the Lilywhites though and his two-point free early in the second half kick-started a run of 1-05 without reply, Harry O'Neill with the goal in the 43rd minute.

Kildare continued to turn the screw with James Harris' late two-pointer sending them on their way.

Thompson, en rota por i USA, é la stëra sora dles scores pro la cualificaziun de Galway por la finala dl FBD

Matthew Thompson, en rota por la California, á ficié dedorof l'balon te rëi por n'analise de 2-06, canche Galway á davagné por 11 punc a Tuam cuntra Leitrim y s'á garanté n post tla finala dla FBD League dla edema che vëgn.

Thompson, nominè sciöche „Young Footballer of the Year“ dl 2025, de n'ará nia la poscibilité de scioghé por döt le campionat de liga y la pröma pert dl campionat prinzipale. Padraic Joyce á confermè che le scioghadú de Salthill-Knocknacarra se dëna sön le Berkeley-College por le proscimo semester.

Al é sté la fegöra prinzipala de n Galway cun tröpes novités - cun ince Cian Hernon y Kieran Molloy - che á peté sö do n svantaje de trëi punc a la fin dl pröm tëmp cuntra Leitrim.

Thompson á ficié n gol tl ciat sora te la pröma pert, mo i campions de Connacht yera d'ancol dër dales boles ressolütes de Killian Gaffney, intratan che Ryan O'Rourke y Jack Kelly á döt d'oi concuisćé punc por Leitrim.

L'alenadú de Galway, Padraic Joyce, protesta cun l'arbitre por na dezijion

Canche Thompson á convertí n penalte t'la secunda pert de la partida, á Galway coiü i punc de n'vitoria tlassea, cun 10 scioghadus desvalis dales scores por n resultat final de 2-19 a 0-14.

Do döes fasedes dles eliminatories de FBD League, i pröms dusc s'á cualifiché por la finala dla edema proscima, canche Galway s'enfrontará cun le davagnadú dla partida danter Roscommon y Mayo de deman.

Tl Leinster á Westmeath conchisté n post te la finala de la O'Byrne Cup, do na vitoria de 11 punc sora d'Offaly, t'na spetacurara d'gols a Mullingar.

Ence de s'enfrunté cun n Kildare svelt, che á davagné Dublin por 1-22 a 1-13.

L'echipa de Westmeath coordinada da Mark McHugh s'á cualificá dan i campiuns de Longford do n'tiré de moneda saba d'antier, mo ai á d'ert fat vëia dër bel te la partida de saba.

Döes dúpies de gol de Danny McCarton y Brandon Kelly, deplü n gol de Senan Baker, á condüt a la vitoria por 5-10 a 2-08.

Ciaran Murphy á segné dui gols danter la faseda dl pröm y dl secundo tëmp por reporté i gosc de gora de d'compagnia, redujend l'vantaie sön trëi punc a 11 menuc tl secundo tëmp.

La d'compagnia á spo concuisćé n rë de 3-02 te i proscimi 15 menuc sënza rezepì na resposta y á archité la vitoria de feter en dër de d'ert.

Kildare á ciafè la drita rota tl secundo tëmp cuntra Dublin y s'atend sën d'ess cun n sul gol dret luntan da la pröma Copa O'Byrne dal 2014 encá.

Harry O'Neill ficia la bala te rëi por Kildare

Döes les copies de staff tecnich á dret fat proves te la faseda dles gares de Newbridge; te la pröma pert Dublin á fat dër bëgn palesá de manco fegöres conesciüdes mo l'vantaie de 1-08 a 0-08 a la fin dl pröm tëmp l'á dit defin al contrari.

Jamie McCarville á ficié de n bel colp de man, mo l'é sté Clyde Burke a ficié impresciun cun de dër biei tirs y dui "orange flags", danter chisc le secund d'gola de na gran cualité.

Alex Beirne s'á coiü en marea de punc por i Lilywhites, y le penalte de dui punc ficié te i pröms menuc dl secundo tëmp á fat inaudiré na seria de 1-05 sënza degügn dles respóstes, cun Harry O'Neill che á segné le gol de vitoria tl 43ejim menút.

Kildare á tigní dret sön la medema drita con la pert finala de James Harris che cun dui punc á s'azertè la finala defin.

Jamie McCarville à spint le balun tla rëi por so gol, mo al é stat Clyde Burke che à ciapà l’atenziun dl publich aladô cun cherti tiri brillanc che à inclodü dui pont da doi - le second de chisc de qualità massima.

Alex Beirne racoiea però pont por i Lilywhites, y so free da doi pont dant tla secunda mesadëda à metü en movimënt n slanç de 1-05 zënza risposta, cun Harry O'Neill che à fat le gol tl 43ejim menüt.

Kildare à cuntinuà a strenjer, cun le doi pont tardif de James Harris che i à dat l’ultim impuls sun la strada dla vitora.

Thompson, en viadi ti Stac Unis, brilëia canche Galway arjën la finala FBD

Matthew Thompson, che va a California, à segnà 2-06, y Galway à superà Leitrim cun 11 pont a Tuam por s’asseguré n post tla finala dla FBD League dla setëmana che vëgn.

Thompson, candidat al premi de Jëuni Jiadour dl Ann 2025, no jiarà nia te duta la liga y tla pert iniziala dl campionat; Padraic Joyce à confermà che le jiadour de Salthill-Knocknacarra studëia a Berkeley por le semëster che vëgn.

Al é stat la figura prinzipala d’na formaziun de Galway en gran pert sperimentala - te chëra che nce Cian Hernon y Kieran Molloy faea pert - canche ai é gnüs da trei pont sot a meza tëmp por bati Leitrim.

Tla pröma mesadëda Thompson à metü a sëgn n gol tl angul aut, mo i campiuns de Connacht é jüs al ripaus sot a Leitrim, cun Killian Gaffney efficace sui baluns piazá, y cun Ryan O'Rourke y Jack Kelly che à nce fat pont.

L’atorenadour de Galway, Padraic Joyce, protestëia cun l’arbitro por na dezijiun

Mo, cun Thompson che à trasformà n penalty tla secunda mesadëda, Galway à porté a ciasa la vitora zënza gran dificolté do la pausa, cun 10 marcadus diferents en dut, y à vintu cun le resultat de 2-19 a 0-14.

Do dui turns dla FBD League, i pröms dui classificá avançëia ala finala dla setëmana che vëgn, cun Galway che jiarà cuntra le vëncedour dl incunté de doman anter Roscommon y Mayo.

In Leinster, Westmeath s’à assegurà so post tla finala dla O'Byrne Cup do na vitora de 11 pont sun Offaly te n partit rich de gol a Mullingar.

A i speté tla finala él n’ëschit de Kildare che à bati Dublin cun 1-22 a 1-13.

L’ëschit de Westmeath de Mark McHugh à passé inant dan ai campiuns regnanc de Longford do n lanç de monëda sabeda passada, mo sabeda ai à impressionà sun le ciamp.

Dui gol ciascun da Danny McCarton y Brandon Kelly, plü n ater da Senan Baker, ai à menà Westmeath ala vitora cun 5-10 a 2-08.

Ciaran Murphy à segnà dui gol, un dan y un do meza tëmp, por mené i giogadus de fora endô tla partida; le dezavantaje é gnü per n curt moment ridot a trei pont 11 menüć tla secunda mesadëda.

Mo n slanç de 3-02 zënza resposta ti 15 menüć sucessifs à permetü ai padru de ciasa de stlar jö la contëisa te maniera neta.

Kildare à ciafà so ritme tla secunda mesadëda cuntra Dublin y ades é a n soul partit da sia pröma O'Byrne Cup dal 2014.

Ate a little more chicken and had a wash. Also had a little more fight when I made her take her fluids last.
We phoned the vet at 830 this morning to ask if they looked under her soft pallet while she was sedated, as she has major ear polyps. Was told the vet would call back. They didn't, rang just now (1645 local) and was told the vet wasn't in today. I was a bit annoyed and said "we paid you over £600 yesterday, you said phone if we have questions, we have questions you're not answering!"
"I don't like your tone, sir "
"It's not your fault personally, but when I pay the better part of a grand I expect a level of service that you're not providing"
"I'll get a vet from the other branch to ring you"

Seeing vet at other practise at half seven for more anti nausea medicine. They're not going to charge out of hours rate as we rang first thing.
Just got another 10ml of rescue fluids into her.

Back. Anti nausea jab, gabapentin, and she's home. Ate some chicken and some cheese.
Got more gabapentin in pill form for her, too

Won't stop eating. Having to slow her down to prevent her from vomiting. She's also absolutely, completely, totally, off her tits. Mullered. Stoned. Caned. Fully in the yellow submarine.
Vet says this'll reset her appetite, or, when we stop giving her painkillers, show it's pain stopping her eating, which would mean medical imaging time.

She's eating a bit, and even played a little, but she's still on the medications so it might be that. Still giving her recovery fluids, which she's still not fighting as she would normally.

Valencia has decided we are all Suspicious. Won't come when called, runs if you go to her. Still comes on her own terms, so it's fine, she's just seen her adoptive sister repeatedly wrapped in a towel and made to drink Stuff, and she wants none of that, thank you very much.

Ming update: she's a little more active, but still floppy and sleeping a lot. She's on two lots of painkillers still, so she's probably fairly stoned.

source_doc:
On a lighter note, just saw someone complaining about when games beg you to switch to easy mode when you fail.
I also hate this.
I love having an easy mode. Hell, I think games should just fuckin' let you cheat, as long as competitions all have agreed-on rules about it.
But every game that's pestered me into easy mode has been an instant put-down. I have plenty of games to play, if you want me to be done faster, congrats, I'm done faster.

This is what makes modern Marios - modern-ish anyway - so impossible for me to play.
"Did you die thwee times mawwio? Here's the golden supersuit of invincibility because you suck! If you don't want it, just carefully avoid ever pressing anything besides "start level yes again no no nothing else just start the level".
This is also why I stopped trying to play Phantom Pain. Whenever I died, it'd offer me the chicken hat and default to "yes", eventually I forgot to manually say "fuck off".

I get it's a retention thing, but it's so disrespectful.
Autoscaling difficulty also pisses me off, because I'll be gearing up for a challenge and then the game will panic and lower it to super easy because I've been "struggling".
I'll die or something, go back to try again, but nope, now the challenge is gone. You succeeded! You made the game go away! Don't worry, those challenges were for someone else. Someone better.
I can't remember if I ever completed a game with autoscaling difficulty.

I guess the basic difference between me and their target audience is that I like to figure out how to do something, while their target audience - at least in their heads - likes to take a log flume through a Disneyworld attraction.
A little jostling, a little fluids, but don't worry, baby, daddy Walt's got ya. You're safey-wafe, you don't even have to move, just sit there and tee hee, here's a wittle splashy-splash.
If I wanted that, I'd go sit in a fucking dog park and pet a dog.

Por n’atra cunt, ai pormez odü valch un che se lamëntia che i jüc te prëia de passé ala modalità lesia deguandé che te dëgnes.
Inće a mi me sciöche l’incherscesć cöst.
A mi me sà bel che al sides na modalità lesia. Ma dai, i mënse che i jüc dësse sciampmënt te lascé barusé, almanco ćina che les competiziuns à dles regoles d’acorde sön cöst.
Ma vigni jüch che m’à rota la scatola por m’enjigné la modalità lesia é stè n stöp immediat. I à n gröm de jüc de d’atri da jöćé, sce te dës che i dësses finé plü bles, complimënć, i à fusté plü d’orco.

Cöst é l’incherscesć che rënd i Mario moderns - o d’aldidancö inće inće - inće inće inće inćina inćina inćina d’orco de jöćé.

source_doc:
And being one of the weirdo, we just frequently get attacks here and there. Either online, offline, or even from your closest people. Those attacks usually stem from homophobia, transphobia, or sometimes just, don't like how weird we are and how weird we act, especially furries that do deeper immersions like roleplaying and therianthropy.

Hence some of us got safety by not needing to tell who we are and where we were from. Some of us got safety by only revealing ourselves to our friends or close friends. Face/body reveal is a culture that most of the furries did at least once in a private post, whether it be "delete soon" kind of post or in story.

Despite being so, we're still open for social interactions offline. We do furmeets—a personal meeting between furries, be it in a group or personal, be it in an event or just casually—and sometimes making a con/fur on, such as MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, and so on. It's fun to meet them offline, get to know each other, be able to see them in person as most of us have never seen each other's faces, take a photo to keep personally and censor publicly, laugh together and discuss similar interests, and so on. It's fun, social, and warm.

Although, things don't feel the same today. As people start trying to strip anonymity of people, attack furries, therian, LGBTQIA, and dox them, as how also our community participate and stir the dramas inside, things has been a little more chaotic, less warm, and less feeling like community or family. It's not the same anymore.

Part of me hopes things can return to how it feels in the 2000s and 2010s, but, I'll just let God do the rest. I'm a little hopeless in society and humans. I'm tired of how things get worse and meant to attack and divide small communities into a hopeless being. I don't like how society is now no longer respecting and being in unity.
model_a_hypos:
Y sciöche un de chi drola, ciafunse gonot atacs chilò y daila. Sibe online, offline, o ince dales porsones plü davescina. Chisc atacs vëgn d'avez da omofobia, transfobia, o val' iade ince porćhed' n i deplaj sciöche i sun drola y sciöche i nos comportun, inće dantalöt i furries che và plü sot tla daintorporaziun sciöche l'interpretaziun de ròli y la teriantropia.

Porchël s'á n valgönes de nos tigní al de socrëza sënza avëi debojëgn de dí chí che i sun y dacandé che i gnôn. Val' iade s'unse tigní al d'archis söl taje mostran sö nos instësc ma ai amisc o ai amisc plü davescina. Mostré le dertal dl ciaf o dl corp é na cultura che la plü gran pert di furries á fat al manco n iade te n post privat, sibe de chi posć "scancela sën" o te na storia.

Ince sce al é sciöche, i sun impò d'ancuntada por interaziuns soziales offline. I jun a d'ancuntades furmeet—n'ancuntada de porsona danter furries, sibe te n grup o de porsona, sibe te n evënt o inće d'öga d'or—y val' iade organizeise na con o furcon sciöche MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, y de d'atri. Al é spave l'ancuntada offline, s'encuëi gní plü davescina, podëi i odëi de porsona postchëi che la majera pert de nos n'á mai odü i dertai dl ciaf d'un l'ater, fá na fotografia da tigní por se y dertoré de furbit te publich, rí d'un n col y baié de de d'atri interes sciöche chisc, y de d'atri fac. Al é bel, sozial y d'afet.

Sö d'aldedré i fac n'é plü i medemi. Sciöche la jënt se mët sö a dertorá d'anonimat, a taché furries, therian, LGBTQIA y a scrí fora i dac privac, sciöche inće la nosta comunité tol pert y dertura i dramesc dedit, i fac é deventá n pü' plü sbalciá, n pü' manco d'afet y al n'é plü chël d'antesć sciöche na comunité o na fana. Al n'é plü le medemo d'un n iade.

N pü' de mé spera che i fac posse indô deventé sciöche d'ansciöche ti agn 2000 y 2010, mo, i m'al lase fá al Signor. I m'un mët n pü' l'inchiet dles porsones y dla sozieté. I sun stanch de sciöche i fac và de mal in pićer y sciöche al é derturé d'ataché y de sparé pićenles comunités te n stât de derschëi. Al m'inchiet d'aldedré na sozieté che n'á plü d'aspet y de d'unité.

source_doc:
Melbourne Renegades host Glenn Maxwell and the Melbourne Stars at Marvel Stadium in BBL15 after Usman Khawaja and Brisbane Heat host Sydney Thunder

Sam Harper dominated with 82 not out off 51 balls and Glenn Maxwell recalled the feeling of ball on bat in a subdued innings of 20 not out off 17 balls, which included one massive six. He has not lost his ability and would have enjoyed the chance to spend time in the middle.

The crowd of 42,846 was not given the contest they hoped for as the Stars won the match by eight wickets with 25 balls remaining.

It keeps Melbourne Stars in contention as they break a three-match losing sequence and makes life hard for Melbourne Renegades. Marcus Stoinis bowled well to take 3-33 and was on a hat-trick at one stage while Harper is in great form having hit 356 runs at a strike rate of 159 for the tournament. He was man-of-the-match.

Tom Rogers bounced back with a fast 50 against Melbourne Renegades

But it was all over once Tom Rogers helped himself to 50 off 19 balls to start the innings with an opening partnership of 84 with Harper.

"They outplayed us at the "G so it was nice to get our fifth win," Harper told Fox Cricket.

Most interesting were the comments from the Fox Cricket commentary box where former England captain Michael Vaughan made it clear how disappointed he was with the way the English hierarchy handled a nightclub incident involving Harry Brook in New Zealand before they arrived in Australia for The Ashes.

Melbourne Stars veteran Peter Siddle said "it was a good turnaround" with the win pushing the team back into second spot on the BBL table.

It's starting to heat up with three games remaining for Melbourne Renegades and two matches for Melbourne Stars.

There is still plenty of cricket left this summer so keep tuning in. Thanks for following. Can the Stars finally win the title?

La fola de 42.846 porsones n'á nia ciafé la partida che a fess speré, sciöche i Stars á davagné la partida por ot wickets cun 25 bales de porsura.

Chësc mantëgn i Melbourne Stars en corsa, sciöche ai á rumpü na secuënza de trëi partides pordüdes y rënd la vita zoruch ai Melbourne Renegades. Marcus Stoinis á joré bun por tó 3-33 y fô sön n hat-trick a n cert momënt, mender che Harper é te n gran momënt, avend batü 356 runs cun na velocité de batüda de 159 por l turnoi. El fô l miú iocadú dla partida.

Tom Rogers é joré zoruch cun un n rabid 50 cuntra i Melbourne Renegades

Ma al fô döt sciampé na bota che Tom Rogers s'á fat de bën cun 50 sön 19 bales por scomencé l'injinn cun na colia d'anchia de 84 cun Harper.

"Ai nes á batü al 'G, porchël fôl bel da ciafé n tesc davagn", á Harper dit a Fox Cricket.

La maiú pert de porsona d'interes fô i comentars dla cabina de coment de Fox Cricket, dër che l'ex-capitan de l'Inghilterra Michael Vaughan á dit tler mender che decolisá al fô cun la drita che la gerarchia d'Inghilterra á traté n incident de n nightclub che á fat Harry Brook te Nea Zelanda denant ch'ai arivass in Australia por The Ashes.

L veteran di Melbourne Stars, Peter Siddle, á dit "al é sté un n bun rionda de rotula" cun la devandada che sburia la colia zoruch al secund post sön la tabela BBL.

source_doc:
Outside of court a never ending stream of flying monkeys has doxxed, harassed and threatened me and anyone they believe have "helped" me in anyway shape or form.
One flying monkey is the tiktoker Areej "liberationluvr" Hakim who jumped on my ex's public posts, and knows my ex privately.
I'll re-post some of their videos about me with a CW.
But I want to make it clear how much these people wish to erase me and my few accomplishments.
Here's violent threats about a witness in my case.

This tiktoker has made it their PRIMARY content to attempt to dox me, my friends and specifically witnesses to my illegal eviction.
In the video they made about me they attempt to paint me as "not an activist", "not a hacker" and "just a grifter".
ALL because my ex decided that splitting bills while navigating a break constituted domestic violence.
They then call their constant online lynch mob chasing me around "activism" and fund raise off MY pain and court process.
#ParentingWhileBlack

Areej "solidarityluvr" is known locally for posting tiktoks of herself stalking + harassing multiple of her ex's all on her tiktok+IG.
Areej maced a trans librarian, Canyon, ON camera as she got off work likely bc Canyon had to enforce BASIC library rules.
Areej cyberbullied Canyon for months after.
Canyon soon thereafter died of a suspected intentional drug overdose.
Many in the community believe Areej's actions directly contributed to Canyon's death.
THESE are the "friends" my ex keeps.

Anywho... this type of leftist infighting, is the worst portlandia coded telenovela ever.
I've NEVER posted anything at all publicly about Areej till now.
Areej did contact me 2years ago with some infighting, which I immediately DECLINED to be involved with.
I had a few private & community conversations about the issues they raised to ensure a restorative justice process had or would occur.
One had occured and had plenty of support so I bowed out.
This had been the extent of our contact.

At the time I bowed out I warned the community against cyber bullying especially 3rd parties to the initial interpersonal conflict.
This warning was directed to Areej, I felt their cyber bullying ON top of the already existing decisions in their favor was in poor taste.
I especially felt Areej doxxing the restorative justice committee/mediators DURING the process was actively abusive.
I warned specifically about the likelihood of Areej's victims self harming being a real risk.
model_a_hypos:
Fora de cort na moscia de complices de mi ex me daciara tres deplëgn, me arfola y me amanaia a mi y a düc chi che ai bëtia che m'ebe dader l'aiüt en valch faza o manira.
Ün de chi colparëis é la tiktokera Areej "liberationluvr" Hakim che s'un é jüda fora sön i posć publics de mi ex y che cugnesce mi ex de porsona.
I cariará inant ciamé valch video de d'ëi sura de me cun n'avertënza de contignü (CW).
Mo i olesse che al fossa cler dër bën tan che chësta jënt m'ess de burt da dles sora y de cancelé i pici ribasć che i ai albü.
Chilo vëgnerel menac violentesc cuntra n testimon te mia decijion.

Chësta tiktokera á fat de so contignü PRINCIPAL le tajo de me daciaré a mi, a mi amisc y spezificamënter ai testimonis de mi desfratöm nia legal.
Te i video che ai á fat sura de me próvun de me depënje sciöche "nia n'ativista", "nia n hacker" y "massa n tarliscedü".
DÜT deache mi ex á dezis che le spartí dles fatures dertan na separaziun representass violënza de familia.
Al vëgn spo definí sciöche "ativism" le fat de me sciampé do tres cun na rassa online che vëgn azaiada sö y de chësta faza fá n checo por i scioldi sön MI de l'ega y sön mia causa te cort.
#ParentingWhileBlack

Areej "solidarityluvr" é conesciüda te la jënt por carisurëles de tiktok de d'ëra instëssa che rorogna + arfola de plü de soi ex, düt sön so tiktok+IG.
Areej á sciurré spray al peve a na bibliotecaria trans, Canyon, DAN la camera dertan che al/ara sciampâ dal lüch de laur, bën dër deache Canyon á düt d'un albü da fá respeté i bunes reigles de la biblioteca.
Areej á fat cyberbullism a Canyon por de pici mënsc do.
Canyon é mort dër dedò, asvelé por n'overdose de d droga aposta.
De plü te la comunité mëtia che i de burt fac de Areej ebe bën dër condüt demez ala mort de Canyon.
CHISC é i "amisc" che mi ex se tëgn artan.

Sce no... chësc tajo de batalies anter de gauche é la piess telenovela coded de portlandia mai oghidore.

I ai albü valch confront privat y te la comunité dertan les problematics che ai á alzà por s'asvelé de na dërcia de reconziliaziun de bona o de faza.
Üna s'un é jüda inant y evel de gran sostëgn por chësc i m'un ai sciampé.
Chësc fova düt le limit de nòsc contat.

Al momënt che i m'un ai sciampé ai avertí la comunité cuntra le cyberbullism de gran faza anter les porsones forestes al conflict intern de porsona d'esperié.

source_doc:
Celtic hammer Dundee United on O'Neill's return

Normal service resumed at Celtic Park as champions Celtic secured a dominant 4-0 win over Dundee United and their first clean sheet since Martin O'Neill's previous game in charge.

Two first-half goals in five minutes from Yang Hyun-jun and Arne Engels sent Celtic on their way as O'Neill returned to the dugout in style following Wilfried Nancy's brief but disastrous reign.

Substitute Benjamin Nygren grabbed his 11th goal of the season and Daizen Maeda netted on the rebound to equal Celtic's two biggest wins of the league season so far. Both of them were in O'Neill's caretaker spell in charge, which resulted in seven wins from eight games.

Celtic sent for the 73-year-old on Monday after terminating Nancy's contract in the wake of six defeats - and 18 goals against - in eight matches.

The chaos, confusion and defensive fragility that marked Nancy's reign disappeared as the Hoops moved three points off the top of the table.

Nobody in the stadium would have been surprised to see O'Neill restore Celtic's long-standing 4-3-3 formation and the team picked up where they left off under O'Neill, as if they had awoken from a nightmare and got on with life as normal.

Centre-back Liam Scales was back to the consistent form he displayed before suffering in and out of a back three under the Frenchman.

Callum McGregor dictated play again and Celtic's wide players, Yang and Sebastian Tounekti, were given attacking licence after being handed wing-back roles by the former Columbus Crew head coach.

Celtic enjoyed 78 per cent possession, had 22 shots at goal and let United have just three. Their opponents averaged 12 shots during Nancy's tenure and United managed 17 themselves during their 2-1 win over the Hoops at Tannadice less than four weeks ago.

Celtic penned United in from the start, with Kieran Tierney instrumental in creating a series of first-half chances.

The left-back had a shot deflected wide, Yang and Scales threatened from headers and Maeda flicked a low cross of the bar, before the pressure paid off in the 27th minute.

Such was Celtic's dominance that Scales found himself in possession on the edge of the box and rolled a pass to Yang, who drilled home from 20 yards.

Maeda soon mis-kicked a volley before Engels produced a first-time finish from Tierney's pass.

It was not all plain sailing for Celtic in the first half. Mexican right-back Julian Araujo marked his first start with a yellow card for a dangerous challenge on Will Ferry, who was still hobbling when he took the resulting free-kick.

United also had chances and Dario Naamo looked unsure whether to head or volley Craig Sibbald's deep cross and did neither and Owen Stirton twice came close.

The striker was firstly foiled by a goal-saving block from Scales after being gifted possession by Auston Trusty and later shot just wide from 18 yards after the Celtic central defence backed off.

United brought on winger Amar Fatah for holding midfielder Pan Camara at half-time but Celtic were even more dominant in the second half.

Reo Hatate and Maeda missed good chances before Nygren shot high into the net from six yards in the 63rd minute.

Maeda had an easy finish six minutes later after Tounekti's shot was saved.

La normalité é jüda inant sön le ciamp de Celtic Park, con i campions dl Celtic che á vadagné daldöt por 4-0 sön le Dundee United y á mantegnü la porta sciuta por le pröm iade do l'ultima partida de Martin O'Neill sciöche trenadú.

Döes gol tes ti pröms cinc d'ora de juat dales fies de Yang Hyun-jun y Arne Engels á metü le Celtic sön la dërtia via, cun O'Neill che á fat so retur sön l'assise di sostituc cun gran stil do la cörta ma sciaria fasa de Wilfried Nancy.

Le sostitut Benjamin Nygren á fat so ünecim gol de la sajun y Daizen Maeda á dagné sön la stofa por lëde i dui majeri deces de la sajun dl Celtic cina d'inchëi. Atri dui fova stac te la fasa de dertur de l'O'Neill, che á portè a set vitores fora de ot partides.

Le Celtic á cherdé le trenadú de 73 agn indolajö de lönesc do ch'an á stlüt le contrat cun Nancy do sies pordüdes - y 18 gol incuntra - te ot partides.

Le caos, la confujiun y la deblëza defensiva che á caraterisé la fasa de Nancy é sparides cun i Hoops che se porta a trëi punc dal pröm post in clasifica.

Degügn tl stacio ne s'ess aspeté nia d'ater co che O'Neill mudass indô al schema de juat storich 4-3-3 dl Celtic, y la scuadra á pité inant sciöche s'an s'ess lü sön i dërs de O'Neill, sciöche s'an s'ess dscedé fora de n sogn döt n müt y s'ess lascé jö cun la vita normala.

Le defensur zentral Liam Scales á dagné so bun iüé ch'al demostrava dagnora denant de s'avëi stancé te na defensiva a trëi sot al franzos.

Callum McGregor á demané indô le juat y i dusc a la lera dl Celtic, Yang y Sebastian Tounekti, á albü le consëi de atach do avëi albü n rol de dusc da ala dal ex trenadú di Columbus Crew.

Le Celtic á albü n posess de bal por le 78 por cent, á fat 22 tirs a la porta y á lascé ma trëi ai aversars dl United. Le Celtic á tignü le United dales fies n döt, cun Kieran Tierney che á iüé n rol fondamental te la creaziun de deplü ocajions ti pröms casc de juat.

Döt döt doi é gnüs sü te la perioda de O'Neill desche interimal da responsabel, che à porté set vittories fora de ot partides.

Le caos, la confujiun y la fragilité difensiva che à marcà le regn de Nancy é descomparüs, cina che i Hoops se à metü a trëi ponts dala cima dla classifica.

Degün te stadion ne sarëssa stat surprais de odëi O'Neill ristablì la lunga tradiziun de Celtic cun la formaziun 4-3-3 y la squadra à taché nce na ota da olache ai s'à lascà sot O'Neill, scu sce ai se foss despertà da n incö de not y foss jit inant cun la vita desche normal.

Le zentrël Liam Scales é stat do torna te la forma costanta che al hadia mostrà dan che al patiss te y fora de na difëisa a trëi sot le francesc.

Callum McGregor à dictà danü l juech y ai jes gnü dada libertad d’atac ai jugadus larghs de Celtic, Yang y Sebastian Tounekti, do che l’anteriur coach principal di Columbus Crew i hadia metüs te rües de esterni bassi.

Celtic à godü de 78 por zënt de posesciun, à fat 22 tîrs en porta y à lascà a United ma trëi. Si aversars à fat na media de 12 tîrs dürant le temp de Nancy y United instësc à fat 17 te sia vittoria por 2-1 cuntra i Hoops a Tannadice manco de cater setmanes indô.

Celtic à seré United ite dal scomenciament, cun Kieran Tierney determinant te la creaziun de na seria de ocasciuns te pröma mësa.

Le terzën de manz à odü n tîr devià fora, Yang y Scales à periculà cun colps de testa y Maeda à tocà cun n colp lëch na cros bassa sora dla traversa, dan che la presciun portass früt te l 27. minüt.

High Noon review - Billy Crudup brings classic Hollywood western back with a bang

How do you turn a classic Hollywood western into West End musical fare? Add songs, many of Bruce Springsteen's in this case, along with a few rounds of line dancing and a sizzling star in Billy Crudup. Still, it's an odd experience initially as Thea Sharrock's production switches from one brief filmic scene to the next, and the endeavour seems as wooden as the clapboard saloon-bar slats that comprise the handsome set.

As a piece of theatre, it finds its flow. As a debate play, though, it gathers a locomotive energy as it travels towards the showdown between Frank Miller (James Doherty), who is returning to this "dirty little village in the middle of nowhere," and the marshal Will Kane (Crudup) who put him behind bars. That is mostly because of the uncanny and urgent relevance of this 1952 film about a community working out (or rather, squirming out of) its civic responsibilities around institutional wrongdoing.

Originally an allegory of McCarthyism (its screenwriter, Carl Foreman, was blacklisted), the story sets the cowardice of the many against the courage of the few - in this case, the lone, heroic Kane, who mobilises his defence against Miller and his henchmen after being let down by the townsfolk. The film was blasted by John Wayne as un-American for its critical portrait of the community; the production comes to life in its arguments on collective in/action and seems to speak directly about the dilemmas facing the cowboy country of Trump's America (the shooting in Minneapolis just the latest example). Eric Roth's script uses many lines from Foreman's screenplay but fleshes out the debates on the ethical stance of a community in the face of wrongdoing and misguided American myths around immigration.

Cowardice of the many, courage of the few ... cast of High Noon. Photograph: Johan Persson

There is also the joint talent of Crudup and the ever agile Denise Gough who play the central couple on their wedding day. She is Amy Fowler, a Quaker who abhors the actions of violent men; he is the marshal who has just given up his "tin star" to start over as a shopkeeper. That is, until news reaches town that Miller is arriving on the noon train.

Gary Cooper made the role entirely his own, his integrity comparable only to Gregory Peck's Atticus in To Kill a Mockingbird. So Crudup has his long shadow to evade. He manages to hold up the part on stage as an upstanding, earnest and increasingly desperate man. Gough makes her part grittier and more modern than that of her film counterpart, Grace Kelly. The pair are convincing as a couple although their narrow characterisation hems in the full scale of their abilities.

Several other characters seem too flimsy, from Billy Howle's deputy marshal, Harvey Pell, to Rosa Salazar's Mexican businesswoman, Helen, although the affinity between her and Amy is refreshing, and Roth gives more voice and texture to these women as a whole.

Several of Springsteen's songs bring their own American politics (from the frontier optimism of Land of Hope and Dreams to The Rising, written in response to 9/11). Some are sung a cappella, mostly by Gough, who is a strong singer, her voice emanating desolation, but she reprises I'm on Fire one too many times.

It seems like a reluctant musical at times, the songs short and thin but the percussive music and sound design are always arresting, as is the lighting, designed by Neil Austin, which brings emotional clarity and intrigue. A clock is central to Tim Hatley's set design, counting down to the train's thrilling arrival and the subsequent showdown, which manages to contain tension and drama, despite the difficulty of staging a cross-town shootout.

For all its early stiffness, it builds in momentum and there are moving moments. Ultimately, the political message speaks loudest, harnessing the McCarthyist fear of then and the Trumpian terror of today.
model_a_hypos:
Recensiun de High Noon - Billy Crudup porta indô le classich western de Hollywood cun n gran bot

Co sciöche dër vëgnel da trasformé n classich western de Hollywood te n musical dl West End? Cun l'ajunta de cianties, deplü de chëres de Bruce Springsteen te chësc cas, adöm cun n valgügn rëis de line dance y na stëra sciöche Billy Crudup che sprancia sciampis. Impò él de pröma jent n'esperienza sciöche dër dules, demez che la produziun de Thea Sharrock passa da na cürtia scena de film al'antra, y l'impëgn parora tan de lëgn sciöche i assuns dl saloon che formëia la bela sena.

Sciöche furest de teater ciafel so flus. Sciöche peza de dëbata, indere, colliëiel n'energia de locomotiva demez che al va devers le scontro final anter Frank Miller (James Doherty), che dërcora indô te chësc "pice paûsc sporch tal mez dl nagut", y le marshal Will Kane (Crudup) che l'â metü do i dats. Chësc dantalöt por via de la fona y urgenta revalënza de chësc film dl 1952 sora na comunité che asproverëia de ciafé na soluziun (o indere de s'en sciampé) da sües dëvites ziviles tocach la colpa de l'istituziun.

There is also the joint talent of Crudup and the ever agile Denise Gough who play the central couple on their wedding day. She is Amy Fowler, a Quaker who abhors the actions of violent men; he is the marshal who has just given up his "tin star" to start over as a shopkeeper. That is, until news reaches town that Miller is arriving on the noon train.

Gary Cooper made the role entirely his own, his integrity comparable only to Gregory Peck's Atticus in To Kill a Mockingbird. So Crudup has his long shadow to evade. He manages to hold up the part on stage as an upstanding, earnest and increasingly desperate man. Gough makes her part grittier and more modern than that of her film counterpart, Grace Kelly. The pair are convincing as a couple although their narrow characterisation hems in the full scale of their abilities.

Several other characters seem too flimsy, from Billy Howle's deputy marshal, Harvey Pell, to Rosa Salazar's Mexican businesswoman, Helen, although the affinity between her and Amy is refreshing, and Roth gives more voice and texture to these women as a whole.

Several of Springsteen's songs bring their own American politics (from the frontier optimism of Land of Hope and Dreams to The Rising, written in response to 9/11). Some are sung a cappella, mostly by Gough, who is a strong singer, her voice emanating desolation, but she reprises I'm on Fire one too many times.

It seems like a reluctant musical at times, the songs short and thin but the percussive music and sound design are always arresting, as is the lighting, designed by Neil Austin, which brings emotional clarity and intrigue. A clock is central to Tim Hatley's set design, counting down to the train's thrilling arrival and the subsequent showdown, which manages to contain tension and drama, despite the difficulty of staging a cross-town shootout.

For all its early stiffness, it builds in momentum and there are moving moments. Ultimately, the political message speaks loudest, harnessing the McCarthyist fear of then and the Trumpian terror of today.

Le film ê gnü criticé forat da John Wayne sciöche nia-american por so retrat critich de la comunité; la produziun ciafa vita te sües dëbates sora l'in/aziun coletiva y parora de comuniché dret sora i dilemes che la tera de vacaruns dl'America de Trump dër speta (les archiopades a Minneapolis d'agost n'é ma l'ultimo ejëmpl). Le codesc de Eric Roth deura deplü rimes dla scenografia de Foreman, ma met dant cun deplü cia dles dëbates sora l'etica d'na comunité danter la colpa y i falis mic de l'America sora la migraziun.

Codardia de tröps, coraje de d'un valgügn... le cast de High Noon. Fotografia: Johan Persson

Te chësc musical dër valf ince le talënt metü adöm de Crudup y dla dagnora agila Denise Gough che iuga la püre dles nozes. D d'ëra é Amy Fowler, na quacra che dërcora la violënza dles jëntes de rabi; d d'el é le marshal che à dagnora lascé demez so "tin star" por mët en pe n pice botëia. Chësc dantalöt, cina che la novité ariva tl paûsc che Miller é dret sön le tren de mezdé.

Gary Cooper à fat le papel dl düt so uriginal, so respet comparable ma a chël de Gregory Peck sciöche Atticus te To Kill a Mockingbird. Ince Crudup à dagnora na gran ombria de chëra che al dër sciampé. Al dër resegüia a mët sö la pert sön la sena sciöche n om dret, dërt y dagnora de plü deperdi. Gough fesc so papel dër plü burt y plü modern de chël dl film de Grace Kelly. La püre n'é d'aurora sciöche püre scebën che la pert de picera jënt sciampia les rës de sües dotes.

Deplü d'atri caraters parora sciöche massa de lëgn, da chël dl vize-marshal Harvey Pell de Billy Howle, a chël dla dënz de botëia Helen, na messicana de Rosa Salazar, scebën che l'afinité anter d'ëra y Amy é dër d'aurora, y Roth dër deura deplü usc y culur a chësc de d'ëres.

Deplü cianties de Springsteen porta la sua pulitica americana (da l'otimism de Land of Hope and Dreams cina a The Rising, scrita do l'11 de setëmber). Un valgügnes vëgn ciantades a cappella, dantalöt da Gough, che é na dër brava ciantarina, so usc dër fona de deperdi, ma d'ëra cianta "I'm on Fire" n dret de plü.

Sön un valgügn momënc parora n musical dert nia d'aurora, les cianties cürtes y dules ma la mujiga de percusciun y l'architetura dl sonn é dagnora d'eceziun, sciöche ince la lüm dl design de Neil Austin che porta sclarimënt y mët gajia. N orlo é le dret de set de Tim Hatley, che mët demez le tëmp cina al'arivada dl tren y al scontro final, che ressegüia dagnora na gran tensiun y drama, dantalöt cun la dificolté de mët en pe na sparada te paûsc.

Cun düt so dër de lëgn dl pröm d'aurora, al va inant dret cun gran gajia y al é de biei momënc. Flascher, le mof pulitich dër deura dret de plü, mët adöm la poia de McCarthian de chi agns cun chëla de Trump al dërt de d'ancuei.

Recensiun de High Noon – Billy Crudup fej torné l western classic de Hollywood cun gran impet

Co se transforma pa n western classic de Hollywood te n musical da West End? An jontan cianties, te chest cajo n gran numer de Bruce Springsteen, adöm cun valch rota de line dancing y na stëila scotanta desche Billy Crudup. Ciononchesto, al scomenc é n’esperiënza valch stranëia, ajache la produziun de Thea Sharrock passa da na curta scëna filmica a chëra do, y l’ensembl para tan de len desche les lates dl saloon-bar che cumpónn la bela scenografia.

Desche toc de teatro, al ciafa so ritmus. Desche drama de discussiun, però, al acumula n’energia da locomotiva mente che al va viers al scontr final anter Frank Miller (James Doherty), che torna te chest “piciul paisc suzi te mes al nia”, y l marshal Will Kane (Crudup), che l’á fat seré. Chësc porvia, soraldut, dla relevanza straordinaria y urgënta de chest film dl 1952 sun na comunité che se confronta cun sües responsabilité ziviches denant ai torts istituzionai – o, plu avisa, che pró da se n liberé.

Originariamenter na alegoria dl maccartism (so scenegiadú, Carl Foreman, fo metü sun la lista niera), la storia met la codardia di plü cunter l curaje di puc – te chest cajo, Kane, eroe solitari, che mobilisëia sia defëisa contra Miller y si complices do che la jënt dl paisc l’á lascé da pert. L film fo critiché da John Wayne desche nia american por so retrat critic dla comunité; la produziun ciafa vita te si argomënc sun l’aziun y la inaziun coletiva y para baié diretamënter di dilemmas che afronta la tera di cowboy dla America de Trump (la sparatoria a Minneapolis n’é che l’ultim ejëmpl). L test de Eric Roth dovra n gran numer de battütes dl scenegé de Foreman, ma svilupëia i debac sun la postura etica de na comunité denant al tort y sun i mituns americans falé tocan l’immigraziun.

Codardia di plü, curaje di puc ... l cast de High Noon. Fotografia: Johan Persson

Nce é ince l talent metü adöm de Crudup y dla semper agila Denise Gough, che jëga la copa centrala te so dé de nozes. Ela é Amy Fowler, na quachera che detesta les azions di oms violënc; el é l marshal che á da pü lascé sia “stëila de lata” por scomenzé da nuef desche botighier. Chësc é insciö fin can la nuvëia riva te paisc che Miller stëgn rivé col tren de mesdí.

Gary Cooper á fat dl role valch dal dut so, cun n’integrité che se po comparé ma cun l’Atticus de Gregory Peck te To Kill a Mockingbird. Cussí Crudup à da schivé na lunga ombra. El riesc a sostigní la pert sun scena desche n om dret, sincer y tresplü disperé. Gough fej sia pert plü aspra y plü moderna co chëra de sia cumpartida cinematografica, Grace Kelly. I dui é convincënc desche copa, inceben che na caraterisaziun massa streta limita la piena mesira de sües capacitês.

Vaire atri personaji para massa debli, dal vice-marshal Harvey Pell de Billy Howle fina a la imprenditora messicana Helen de Rosa Salazar, inceben che l’afinité anter ela y Amy é rinfrescanta, y che Roth dá, te l’insieme, plü usc y consistënza a chestes femes.

Vaires cianties de Springsteen porta cun sëes sia propria politica americana, dal optimism dla frontiera de Land of Hope and Dreams fina a The Rising, scrita desche resposta ai atach dl 11 de setëmber. Ciertes vëgn ciantades a cappella, suraldut da Gough, che é na ciantadura de forza y che, cun sia usc, emana desolaziun; ma la reprënta I’m on Fire n pô massa de iadi.

A trëi momënc para n musical restiu, cun cianties curtes y sotiles; ma la musica percussiva y l design dl son é tres captivanc, desche ince la iluminaziun de Neil Austin, che porta clareza emotiva y intriga. N relogio é zentral tla scenografia de Tim Hatley, contan jö i momënc fina a l’arrivada palpitanta dl tren y al confront che vëgn do, che mantëgn tensiun y drama, malgrad la dificulté de meter sun scena na sparatoria tras dut l paisc.

Malgrad sia rigideza iniziala, la produziun ciafa impet y regala momënc comovëi. A la fin, l mëssaj politich é chël che resonëia plü fort, metan adöm la pora maccartista de n’outa cun l terror trumpian de incö.

source_doc:
"An utterly miserable day": Kempton Park meeting marred by death of three horses

The Lanzarote Hurdle card at Kempton Park was marred by the death of three horses, including the Grade One-winning Kalif Du Berlais, whose loss Paul Nicholls described as "a big kick in the teeth" and a "sad day."

Kalif Du Berlais - whose ownership group includes Sir Alex Ferguson - unseated Harry Cobden in the four-runner Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase and landed lame, with the broken shoulder he sustained proving untreatable and he was euthanised by the veterinary team on Saturday.

Nicholls said: "It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone, the owners, the poor girl who looks after him - you hate to see that happen. He was just showing his class today, he jumped and travelled well and sadly now he will never be able to show the potential we thought he had.

"I can say as much as I like, but it's just a shame for the whole team. Harry was extremely upset and is missing his ride in the last as he doesn't feel great about it. He's a big, bold horse who attacks his fences and those horses, when they do that, can end up having a bad fall.

"He was enthusiastic today and travelling beautifully and we'll never know where we would have ended up, we've always had a lot of faith in him. These things happen, sadly, and we'll have to try to pick ourselves up and move forward. These horses get the best of everything, there's not much you can say to make it better at this point.

"It never gets any easier when these things happen and it's a big old blow."

In the Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, Jonjo and AJ O'Neill's Peso was pulled up on the flat with an injury that could not be treated, leaving racecourse vets with no choice but to euthanise him.

Harry Derham saddled Wertpol for the juvenile hurdle and the horse looked to be running a huge race before falling at the last and sustaining a life-ending injury. Derham said on his X account: "An utterly miserable day at Kempton Park today losing Wertpol who we only had the good fortune of having in our yard for a short period of time.

"It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone," said Paul Nicholls. Photograph: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"He was a bright talent who was fresh and happy doing his work every day, often playing around and expressing himself. He loved his job and I am so sad for his Heart Of The South syndicate, who are the most wonderful group of people. Racing can at times be a painful sport and today has been a tough day for a number of connections. A day to forget."

A spokesperson for Kempton Park said: "All of us at Kempton Park care deeply about the welfare of all racehorses, as do the thousands of racing staff who provide them with world-class levels of care at home every day. Our heartfelt condolences are with the connections of all three horses."

"Na de porvëles de de mizeria": l'incontter a Kempton Park marred dala mort de trëi ciavai

La Cherta dl Lanzarote Hurdle a Kempton Park é stada segnada dala mort de trëi ciavai, danter chisc Kalif Du Berlais, venciadú de un n Grade One, che süa porduda é stada descrita da Paul Nicholls sciöche "n gran pof te dinc" y n "trist de."

Kalif Du Berlais - che danter i propritars á ince Sir Alex Ferguson - á sciamporé de sela Harry Cobden tl Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase cun cater partezipanc y é tomé jö zop, cul sciome rot che al á patí che s'á mostré nia varíbel y al é stat eutanisó dal grup de veterunars le sabeda.

Nicholls á dit: "Al é n trist de col s'un pord d'i ciavai sciöche chisc, al é dör por döt le grup. Al é n gran pof te dinc por düc, i propritars, la pora mütiga che s'un fistidies - an dëscia nia odëi che al suzedi zeche de te'. Al s'á pro l' de d'incö mostré te süa tlassa, al á sciampé y viaié bun y ince sfortunatamenter scenó al ne sará mai pi de porsu de mostré le potenzial che i cherdên che al á."

"I m'un poss ince dì d'i rües, ma al é dër n de rü d'la desfortuna por döt le grup. Harry s'á insciö scurié dër scem y l'é sté manco de de de pi d'le rode te l'ultimo mument canche al ne s'á nia sintí dër bun. Al é n ciaval gran, dër coragius che atachëia i stacujes y chisc ciavai, canche ai fajëi chësc, i pól finí che ai á na gran toma."

"Al é sté dër entusiasmé d'incö y viaiava dër de bel y i n'un mài pi de saé canche s'un füssun arjunc, i un sèmper albü tröpa fiduziara te d'él. Chëstes coses suzed, sfortunatamenter, y i m'un dëscion indré de nes lparé de müt y de jí inant. Chisc ciavai ciafa le mender de döt, al n'é nia de tröp de dit che al mënsc por mi d'incö fòrse de mioré la situaziun."

"Al ne dvënta mai pi de bocia canche chëstes coses suzed y al é n gran pof."

Tla Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, l' Peso de Jonjo y AJ O'Neill é stat fermá sön le plan cun na ferida che ne podô nia gní varida, scenó les veterunars de d'la pista n'á d'altr’ alternative che de le eutanisé.

Harry Derham á fistidié Wertpol por le juvenile hurdle y l' ciaval s'á mostré d'esse insciö de de na gran corsa danter de tomé jö pro l'ultimo y d'avëi de na ferida de de mort. Derham á dit sön sü cont X: "Na de porvëles de de mizeria a Kempton Park d'incö cul pordi Wertpol che i un albü por de na fortura de n mument d'avëi te nosc lüch de porsu por n cürt de."

"Al é n trist de col s'un pord d'i ciavai sciöche chisc, al é dör por döt le grup. Al é n gran pof te dinc por düc," á dit Paul Nicholls. Fotografia: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"Al fova n gran talent che fova dër de bel y cuntent de fé sü labor d'ogni de, sovenz fajëi i jüc y de se mostré. Al i de porsu de sü labor y i sun dër de scem por sü Heart Of The South syndicate, che é le pi bel de de grup de jënt. Les gares pó de d'i muments esse n sport de dolur y d'incö s'á mostré n de dör por n valgügn de d'i propritars. Un n de da s'un desmentié."

Un n portavox de Kempton Park á dit: "Düc nos de Kempton Park s'un fistidiun dër por le bënestar de düc i ciavai de gara, sciöche d'i milies de d'i laoranc de d'les gares che i á conzed d'i mënsc ners de de niancia d'ogni de a ciasa. Les nostes plü sodes condolianzes de d'i cors a düc i propritars de d'i trëi ciavai."

Robin Roefs" penalty saves secures Sunderland's spot in FA Cup fourth round

Get the Adam Clery Football Column. A newsletter that unpacks the absurdities and oddities of the beautiful game

The ACFC newsletter: unpacking football's absurdities

Unpack football's oddities with the ACFC newsletter

Robin Roefs was Sunderland's hero as Everton's FA Cup hopes came to a premature end once again after three woeful penalties in a shootout saw the Black Cats reach round four.

David Moyes" threadbare squad looked like exiting in normal time until James Garner's 89th-minute spot-kick cancelled out Enzo Le Fee's brilliant first-half strike.

But extra time was the last thing the hosts, down to just 12 senior players, needed and when the shootout came around Garner, Thierno Barry and Beto all saw their efforts saved by Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka and Luke O'Nien confidently scored their first three attempts to help Sunderland into the fourth round for only the second time in 11 seasons.

It was a hammer blow to Everton, who were dragged back into the game by Adam Aznou, a £7.8million signing from Valladolid in the summer who had not had a sniff of first-team action.

The teenager's only senior football was two appearances in the EFL Trophy back in September and October and his 86th-minute introduction for Merlin Rohl was only because Moyes had little to no option.

But the Spanish-born Moroccan showed more drive in the four minutes of regulation time than many of his battle-weary team-mates had in the preceding 86 - particularly fellow 19-year-old and summer arrival Tyler Dibling, who cost five times as much.

Within three minutes he won an admittedly soft penalty after a shoulder-to-shoulder challenge by Trai Hume allowing Garner to equalise.

Replays of the foul on the big screens at full-time enraged Xhaka, who hurled his water bottle into the turf and raged at the perceived injustice to anyone in earshot, but the Black Cats" captain was soon celebrating.

It is rare for Sunderland, promoted from the Championship last season, to be favourites in any game but the fact Regis Le Bris was able to make five changes and still have the likes of Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete and Wilson Isidor in reserve swung the odds in their favour.

Injuries, the Africa Cup of Nations and suspensions for Michael Keane and Jack Grealish were compounded by Tim Iroegbunam's hamstring problem which took the absences to nine.

Barry, the one senior player he left out, accounted for 23 of the 27 first-team appearances among the substitutes with five of six academy players not having previously featured at all.

After Harrison Armstrong sliced wide their only first chance of the first half, Sunderland took control and should have been comfortably ahead by the interval.

Their first shot resulted in the opener - and what a goal.

Everton failed to deal with a long throw and Eliezer Mayenda teed up Le Fee to send a cushioned right-footed volley curling past Jordan Pickford.

Moyes had a face like thunder and his demeanour was not improved as Pickford clawed away a Nordi Mukiele overhead kick and tipped away, at full-stretch, Romaine Mundle's strike from distance.

Surprisingly, the Everton boss did not make the only change available to him and sacrifice one of his five midfielders for Barry at the start of the second half, but they did not come to life until Mayenda rolled an angled shot just wide with less than half an hour remaining.

Beto's appeal for a penalty for a shirt pull by Hume was waved away but referee John Brooks obliged when Aznou went down and Garner equalised.

Unfortunately for Everton their subsequent penalties were not as confident, with Barry and Beto's stuttering run-ups far from convincing, as Roefs saved all three.

La newsletter de ACFC: splighé fora les absurditesć dl football

Descoveresc les de bizes dl football cun la newsletter de ACFC

Robin Roefs é sté l'eroe dl Sunderland, degolesc che les speranzes dl Everton ti dërts dla FA Cup é jüdes de fia a nia n'andra de rënd do trëi de bogn penalties sciurá sciöche nia te na fasa de penalties che á portá i Black Cats al cuarto rënd.

L'ecuipa dër strënta de David Moyes pargora de jorá fora ti agnoc normai inant che n penal de James Garner al 89ejim menüt anolass le gol de fanta de Enzo Le Fee te la pröma pert dl jüch.

Ma i agnoc de estension fova l'ultima cossa che i d'ciasa mervëia, cun mé 12 joradus de esperiënza, adora, y canche la fasa de penalties é rovada, Garner, Thierno Barry y Beto á düć conesciü i sforz parés da Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka y Luke O'Nien á trat cun sgürëza i pröms trëi proi de penalter por iüté le Sunderland a rové tl cuarto rënd por la secunda iada te 11 sajuns.

Chësc é sté n gran tarlon por l'Everton, che é sté trat zoruch tl jüch da Adam Aznou, n joradú de 7,8 miliuns de sterlines cherdé dal Valladolid de d'aspi, che no m'aveva d'antruché nia deplü de jüch de pröma ecuipa.

L'unich football senior dl joradú de mender etá fova stades döes apariziuns tl EFL Trophy en setëmber y utober y so joré al 86ejim menüt por Merlin Rohl é sté mé deache Moyes n'aveva nia tröpes de alternatives.

Ma le marochin de nscer spanola á desmostré deplü forza te i cater menüć de jüch normal de chël che de tröć de si joradus de ecuipa stanc de batalia m'aveva fat ti prezedenć 86 - dantal düt l'oter joradú de 19 agn y arivé de d'aspi Tyler Dibling, costé cinch iades deplü.

Inco de trëi menüć al á vadagné n penal, mënco sclet por na batalia sciola a sciola cun Trai Hume, m'permeton a Garner de rowé de pari.

I replis dla falia sön i gragn scherms al terminal dl jüch á furié Xhaka, che á sciuré so fiasch d'ega por tera y á furié cuntra l'ingiustizia desmostrada a d'agn de oredla, ma le capitan di Black Cats s'á tost complajü.

Al é dër ror por le Sunderland, pié ia dala Championship la sajun colada, d'ester i ganeiturs predilicć te d'aresgn de jüch, ma le fat che Regis Le Bris fova tl dërt de fá cinch mudamënć y avëi d'aries sciche Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete y Wilson Isidor en resserva á mudé les speranzes te so dërt.

Danjes, la Copa d'Africa y les suspisciuns por Michael Keane y Jack Grealish é stades acompagnades dal problem al garët de Tim Iroegbunam che á portá les d'asenies a nio.

Barry, l'unich senior d'aspi che al á lascé d'or, á curí 23 de les 27 apariziuns de pröma ecuipa danter i sustituicć cun cinch de si sis academy players che no m'aveva d'antruché nia de pröma fat inant.

Do che Harrison Armstrong á sciuré d'or süa sola pröma ocajiun dla pröma pert, le Sunderland á ciafé le control y m'avess podü ester inant cun comfort inant le travert de palsa.

So pröm tire á portá al gol d'aria - y ce n gol.

L'Everton n'é nia sté tl dërt de gestí n lonch lancia y Eliezer Mayenda á passá la bala a Le Fee por n tire al völ de dërt amorté che á passá Jordan Pickford.

Moyes á conesciü na sburla sciöche n de tarlon y süa manira de fá n'é nia d'amiorada canche Pickford á sprigorá d'aria n tire d'aria de Nordi Mukiele y á sprigorá d'aria, dër spestorá, le tire de colier de Romaine Mundle da lonsch.

D'aria de sorps, le capitan de l'Everton n'á nia mudé süa sola mudaziun por anolé un de si cinch mesanjerins por Barry al scomënciamënt de secunda pert, ma ai n'é nia gnüs de fia inant che Mayenda á sciuré n tire de cania dër d'or cun mënco de na mesa d'ora restanta.

La d'man de Beto por n penal por na tircada de blusa de Hume é stada lasciada de cania, ma l'arbitre John Brooks á fat de dërt canche Aznou é jü de tera y Garner á rovada de pari.

Desfortüna por l'Everton, si penalties con-sequenć n'é nia stá de sciöche dër de confidenza, cun Barry y Beto che m'aveva corides dër de bizes inant che Roefs á paré düć trëi.

L'unich football senior dl joradú de mender etá fova stades döes apariziuns tl EFL Trophy en setëmber y utober y so joré al 86ejim menüt por Merlin Rohl é sté mé deache Moyes n'aveva nia tröpes de alternatives.

Ma le marochin de nscer spanola á desmostré deplü forza te i cater menüć de jüch normal de chël che de tröć de si joradus de ecuipa stanc de batalia m'aveva fat ti prezedenć 86 - dantal düt l'oter joradú de 19 agn y arivé d'aspi Tyler Dibling, costé cinch iades deplü.

I replis dla falia sön i gragn scherms al terminal dl jüch á furié Xhaka, che á sciuré so fiasch d'ega por tera y á furié cuntra l'ingiustizia desmostrada a d'agn de oredla, ma le capitan di Black Cats s'á tost complajü.

Danjes, la Copa d'Africa y les suspisciuns por Michael Keane y Jack Grealish é stades acompagnades dal problem al garët de Tim Iroegbunam che á portá les d'asenies a nio.

Barry, l'unich senior d'aspi che al á lascé d'or, á curí 23 de les 27 apariziuns de pröma ecuipa danter i sustituicć cun cinch de si sis academy players che no m'aveva d'antruché nia de pröma fat inant.

Do che Harrison Armstrong á sciuré d'or süa sola pröma ocajiun dla pröma pert, le Sunderland á ciafé le control y m'avess podü ester inant cun comfort inant le travert de palsa.

So pröm tire á portá al gol d'aria - y ce n gol.

L'Everton n'é nia sté tl dërt de gestí n lonch lancia y Eliezer Mayenda á passá la bala a Le Fee por n tire al völ de dërt amorté che á passá Jordan Pickford.

Moyes á conesciü na sburla sciöche n de tarlon y süa manira de fá n'é nia d'amiorada canche Pickford á sprigorá d'aria n tire d'aria de Nordi Mukiele y á sprigorá d'aria, dër spestorá, le tire de colier de Romaine Mundle da lonsch.

La rosa ridota de David Moyes paraia destinada a jí fora te i 90 menüć, enchin che l rigour dl 89. menüt de James Garner à anulé l splëndid gol de Enzo Le Fee dla pröma mesadà.

Mo la proroa êra la ultima cossa che i parons de ciasa, reducì a demé 12 jügadus seniors, avëssa bujü, y canche é rivada la seria di rigours, Garner, Thierno Barry y Beto à odü süs tîc paré da Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka y Luke O'Nien à segnà cun sigürezza süs pröms trëi tentatifs por porté l Sunderland te la quarta runda demé por la secunda ota te 11 stagions.

Al é stat n colp pesënt por l Everton, che é stat retrat ite te la partida da Adam Aznou, n acquist de 7,8 miliuns de sterlines da Valladolid d’insté, che n’â ciamó nia giaté post te la pröma squadra.

Al é rar che l Sunderland, promové fora dla Championship la stagiun passada, sidesse favorit te valch partida, mo l fat che Regis Le Bris podêssa fé cinch mudaziuns y avëi ciamó te reserva jügadus coche Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete y Wilson Isidor à fat pëndëi les probabilités a sü favor.

I malans, la Coppa d’Africa y les suspensiuns por Michael Keane y Jack Grealish é gnüs agravés dal problem muscular de Tim Iroegbunam, che à porté les assënzes a nö.

Barry, l’unich jügadur senior lassé fora, rapresentâ 23 dles 27 apariziuns dla pröma squadra anter i sostitüc, cun cinch di ses jügadus dl’academia che n’â mai jüé dant.

Do che Harrison Armstrong à sburté fora largia sia soula vera ocajiun dla pröma mesadà, l Sunderland à tut l control y avess mess jí al paus cun n vantaje comod.

So pröm tir à porté al gol dl vantaje - y che gol.

L’Everton n’à nia savü gestí n lanç lungh y Eliezer Mayenda à preparé la bala por Le Fee, che cun na volada amortida col pê dërt à mandé la bala a curvé do Jordan Pickford.

Moyes â na faza scüra coche n temporal y so atejamënt n’é nia ameglioré canche Pickford à para cun gran fadia na rovesciada de Nordi Mukiele y, alungé al massim, à devié n tir da lunh de Romaine Mundle.

Por surprëisa, l coach dl Everton n’à nia fat al scomenc dl secundo tëmp l’unica mudaziun a desposiziun, cioé sacrifiché un di sü cinch centrocampisc por Barry, mo la squadra n’é gnüda a vita enchin canche Mayenda à mandé n tir angolé demé de fora cun manco de mesa ora da jüé.

L’apel de Beto por n rigour por n tiron de maia da Hume é stat ignoré, mo l arbitro John Brooks à indiché l punt blanc canche Aznou é cialé por tera y Garner à parejé.

Desfortüna por l Everton, i rigours che à seguité n’é nia stac tant sigürs, cun les rincorses interotes de Barry y Beto dal dut nia convincentes, y Roefs à paré düc y trëi.

Ashley Barnes at the double as Burnley claim welcome win over Millwall

Ashley Barnes bagged a brace as Burnley put their Premier League worries on hold to cruise into the fourth round of the FA Cup with a 5-1 win over Millwall.

The 36-year-old scored his first goal of the season early on and added his second midway through the second half as the blundering Lions gifted a confident home side the most emphatic of wins.

Boss Scott Parker made eight changes to the side that started in Wednesday's 2-2 draw with Manchester United and they did not disappoint, as further goals from Loum Tchaouna and Jaidon Anthony put them out of sight by half-time.

Substitute Jaydon Banel added Burnley's fifth on the stroke of 90 minutes before the shell-shocked Lions, who had completely capitulated, netted an added-time consolation through Josh Coburn.

Burnley dominated the opening exchanges and grabbed the lead in the 11th minute when Jacob Bruun Larsen squared for Barnes to sweep home past visiting goalkeeper Steven Benda.

The Lions mustered little in response, with Aidomo Emakhu booting their best chance straight at Burnley keeper Max Weiss after being released down the left by Joe Bryan.

But the visitors slowly grew into the game and should have levelled when Jake Cooper got his head on Alfie Doughty's cross from deep on the left but was denied by a brilliant over-arm save from Weiss.

The keeper saved again from Cooper on the half-hour as Millwall threatened a leveller but the visitors were undone by two defensive errors that put the game beyond their grasp.

Tchaouna was allowed to thread his left-foot shot from the edge of the box past a static Benda on 35 minutes and shortly before the break the Millwall keeper's poor clearance ultimately gifted Anthony the chance to slide home his side's third.

Millwall looked livelier at the start of the second half and Thierno Ballo should have done better when he found space to get a shot off in the left side of the box, but the home side were clearly in cruise control.

Tchaouna came close to his second when he rifled a shot against the outside of Benda's right-hand post and the increasingly inevitable fourth arrived on 65 minutes when Kamarl Grant made a hash of clearing Anthony's right-wing cross and a delighted Barnes mopped up.

Hunting for a hat-trick, Barnes flashed a header straight at Benda as the linesman's flag was raised, but it was Banel who completed the rout from close range before Coburn's confident finish in stoppage time.

Dopla por Ashley Barnes y le Burnley davagnëia dër ion cuntra le Millwall

Ashley Barnes á fat na dopleta y le Burnley á lascé da na pert les preocupaziuns de Premier League por passá plajorbelmënter al cuarto torn de FA Cup cun na vitoria por 5-1 cuntra le Millwall.

Le jore de 36 agn á sciuré sice pröm gol dla sajun bën adora y á fat le secundo a mesa la secunda fasa dl jüch, ince deache i Lions á sciurá dër dales man y á daddoman al’ecuipa de ciasa sotescrita la vitoria piö tlara che n’e s’aspetâ nia.

L’allenadú Scott Parker á fat ot mudamënc ti joradus de baje che â scomenzé la partida d’en jöbia deache al s'â stlüt jö cun un n 2-2 cuntra le Manchester United, y ai n’á nia delüt: i gundis fac da Loum Tchaouna y Jaidon Anthony mënena bën adora ti pröms descors na vitoria de sigonda descureia.

Le sostitut Jaydon Banel á fat le chinto gol por le Burnley dlungia le menüt 90, inant che i spaventá Lions, che s'â daldöt dac sö, fajess n gol de consola ti menüc de recupero cun Josh Coburn.

Le Burnley á dominé i pröms momënc dla partida y á tut la devandesta al menüt 11, canche Jacob Bruun Larsen á passè la bales a Barnes che á frapé de dër man dlungia le portier di ghes Steven Benda.

I Lions á fat dër pücia reaziun, cun Aidomo Emakhu che á sparé süa mender ocajiun dër cuntra le portier dl Burnley Max Weiss do ch’al ê gnü lissé söl’ciamp a man dërca da Joe Bryan.

Ma i ghes á bel plan scomenzé a cresci par rionje l’egalité canche Jake Cooper á daddorú de ciaf söl cross de Alfie Doughty dales dërcis pro dles linies, ma al é gnü sturcé da n gran paré de Weiss.

Le portier á inno de n paré a Cooper al mez de l’ora de jüch canche le Millwall ciarâ de fá l’egalité, ma i ghes s'un é dac sö por gaujia de dui fai dla defensia che á portè la partida daldöt defora da süa porteda.

Tchaouna á ciafé le spacio de cané n colp de dërcia dales dërcis dles linies dla dërcia dlungia Benda al menüt 35, y püch dan l’intervallo, la debla sparada dl portier dl Millwall á daddoman a Anthony la dërta ocajiun de scrí le terzo gol por süa ecuipa.

Le Millwall se fariâ plö jorënt al scomenz dl secundo tëmp y Thierno Ballo dess ciafé dër deplö canche al á daddorú n spacio de ciaf por frapé dlungia la pert dërcia dla linia de ciamp, ma l’ecuipa de ciasa d’en gaujia controlâ bën bëgn le jüch.

Tchaouna é sté dër dlungia al secundo gol canche al á frapé n colp de forza dlungia le post dërc dl portier Benda, y le cuarto gol che un s'aspetâ bel plan é gnü al menüt 65 canche Kamarl Grant n’é nia sté bun de paré n cross da la linia dërca de Anthony, y Barnes á mënè bën la bales de dër lio do ch’al s'â despolé.

Inant che al fess na tripleta, Barnes á frapé de ciaf dër dlungia Benda canche la bandira dl daddoman de linia ê piada sö, ma al é sté Banel a fá le gol dla debla rüina da dër dlungia, dan che Coburn stlüss jö la partida cun süa gran vitoria ti menüc de recupero.

Today's Sunday Best features my Knight from Ragnarok Online! This was my very first online PC game, he was an agi/dex 2HQ knight w/ a set of elemental claymores. I played on iRO Loki, and had two drawings featured as loadscreen art!
My online handle stems from this guy. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Coming in just under the wire on today's Sunday Best, it's my Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! The loadout I ran most of the time was Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. I think the LOK-1 is one of the coolest weapon designs in an FPS, a lock-on mechanic that encouraged finesse & deep mastery.

This week's Sunday Best is my Xenoverse OC, Parma (for parmesan cheese). She had a partner named Brie. Parma dressed up to match the teachers she studied under, but her final fit reflected the one she started with, styled to match this one pair of gloves. She used Giant Storm & Double Sunday a lot.

For my Sunday Best I drew my Paxultek from Remnant II. The goal of my build was to make the damage number from a single shot as large as possible. I used a Widowmaker single-shot elephant rifle we nicknamed The Governor. It was so strong it one-shot teammates through friendly fire damage reduction.

Today's Sunday Best features my funny gay dog lady from Webfishing. Her voice had a deeper, slower pitch so she sounded old & chill. One time I joined a full server, sat somewhere & started posting practical life advice, bits of big-sister wisdom, & the whole server found me & sat with me to listen.

It's Sunday, today's feature is my Darktide Zealot. Her name is Callista, she's chasing sainthood to be pardoned of her many crimes so she won't have to apologize for any of them. She has black dreams full of teeth and is constantly flirting with female Loner Psykers. She's unwell, but Female Loose Cannon Veterans think it's endearing and constantly hit on her for it. Their in-game voices say all of this.

Today's Sunday Best feature is QP from 100% Orange Juice! I played OJ a lot with my fighting game friends; for some reason I'd always have the hand pictured here. We used to post in text chat during games and I'd always say, Do NOT test me. I played so much QP the devs awarded me a special QP badge!

This week's Sunday Best is "Local Psychopath," Fem Boss #1 from Saint's Row 3. This was the first game I wanted to use the create-a-feature to make a character who blended in with the cast and looked like a genuine member of the Third Street Saints. I picked 3 cuz my favorite jacket wasn't in 4. :(

For today's Sunday Best I've got my Animal Crossing Villager to share. My favorite way to play these games is as part of a global cartel of goons who shared their wealth. When one person had big Turnips, everyone got paid. No profiteering; you need a rare item to make your room idea work? We got you.

It's technically Sunday, and this week's fit lands a bit early! I don't Tekken very often, but when I do I like to pick Steve and do all his slippery punches. In Tekken 7 he had a loose-fit, full-body track suit, so I made him into a deer man. When he's in Peekaboo Stance the antlers point forward!

This week's Sunday Best feature is Gaige from Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy is one of the coolest FPS mechanics in the genre, an escalating accumulation of power that came with a diminishing level of control, lowering both TTK & effective range. Ride the wave & figure it out on the fly, it'll be fine.
Gaige's voice actress plays V in Cyberpunk 2077, I learned recently. An old friend.

Today's Sunday Best isn't a person, it's a plane from an old Vlambeer game called Luftrausers! The music changes to match your airplane. My favorite configuration is called "Shipwreck," a sword-hulled amphibious prop plane with shotgun cannons, it can divebomb through boats & burst up from the sea.

Tonight our Sunday Best feature is the Houndmaster from a charming Crawl-like sidescroller called Vagante. Lovingly referred to as the Dogmancer, I loved to spec into skills that increased damage when you threw the dog at monsters. The dog roams on its own, but you can also carry it on your back!

For this week's Sunday Best we're going all the way back to Cyborg Justice on the Genesis. I played this game a lot and I always liked to make this one guy: round torso, big stampy feet and the buzzsaw hand. I always remember the magazine ad for this game vividly; you might too if you're of an age.

I did a bit of archaeological research to uncover references for this week's Sunday Best. This was my guy from Loadout, a third-person arena shooter about fiddly weapon customization. My main gun was an electric pulse cannon called "Kill-a-Watts" and the backup was a flaming LMG named "Roast Beef."

Por mi Sunday Best i ai dessigné mi Paxultek da Remnant II. Le gol de mia build fova de fà n numer de deces de n col de sora sciöche dër le plü gran poscibl. Le Sunday Best de sciöche incö mët dant la mia jöstra de cian gay de Webfishing. Süa usc fova plü dees, plü plan, insciö che al sunova sciöche na dër vedla y trancuila. Una n d’edema s’unse sciolé mënter che la dër server fova plen, me sun sciada y ai scomencé a scrî consëis pratics de deces, pici tòc de deces de na sor gran, y dut le server m'ha ciafé y se sun sciades de d’edles por ascuté.

Al é domënia, y incö él le Zelota de Darktide. Al se tlama Callista, y al va do al dezes de deces por d’ester pordoné de sües dër crimes por n’avëi nia da se scusé de nagota. Les usc söl jüch al dij döt chëst.

Le Sunday Best de sciöche incö é QP de 100% Orange Juice! I scioghei tröp a OJ cun i amisc di jücs de deces; por n val’ dezes resons i ai dagnora la man che vën chiló dant deza. Chëst fova le pröm jüch olache i i voria adoré la dezes de creazion por fà n personaje che s'unissa cun i autri y sciöche n dër member di Third Street Saints. Le Sunday Best de incö n’é nia na dër deces, ma n deces d’avion d’un dezes de jüch de Vlambeer che se tlama Luftrausers! La deces cambia por s’unì cun tüa dër deces. My favorite configuration is called "Shipwreck," a sword-hulled amphibious prop plane with shotgun cannons, it can divebomb through boats & burst up from the sea.

Chësta sëra d’incö, le sciöche de Sunday Best é le Houndmaster d’un sidescroller dret d’amisc d’un Crawl che se tlama Vagante.
